wizards.name: Ilyra Voss
wizards.title: The Lenskeeper
wizards.casting_mode: Held reticle convergence: sustained focus narrows two aim rings.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary for 0.20–0.70 s while aiming; release to cast. Cast Modifier displays a target-sized practice guide; it never chooses a target.
wizards.normal_cast: Release after at least 0.20 s for the spell’s normal effect. Releasing earlier queues a normal cast at 0.20 s; cancel releases the queue without spending.
wizards.mastery: Keep the aim vector within a 2-degree cone for the final 0.25 s and release with rings aligned: next direct spell gains 12% projectile speed, or 12% lower windup for nonprojectile spells, never both. Moving targets still require manual tracking.
wizards.signature: Lens Split — 16 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Place two visible glass screens, each 1.5 m wide with 30 health, within 6 m for 3 s. Any projectile crossing one screen loses 15% speed once, including the caster’s; melee destroys screens normally. They do not block sight, hitscan, or movement and occupy one field allocation together.
wizards.passive: Clear Focus — after standing or walking without sprint for 0.8 s, the next ranged direct spell costs 5% less mana; resets on cast, sprint, or dodge. Combines within the 20% casting-efficiency limit.
wizards.range_preference: Long range; seeks stable lanes.
wizards.weakness: Focus gives opponents a readable line and loses its reward when forced to flick suddenly.
wizards.counterplay: Break sight with steam or cover, attack from changing elevations, and close during the held focus. Walk around or strike Lens Split screens.
wizards.lore: A former observatory surveyor treats battle as measurement under pressure.
wizards.visual_identity: Brass sight rings, a cropped cobalt mantle, and visibly converging concentric light.
wizards.audio_identity: Quiet glass chimes rising toward a single clean release tone.

wizards.name: Bram Cinder
wizards.title: The Kilnheart
wizards.casting_mode: Pressure release: charge a forge gauge and vent at its crest.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary for 0.20–0.60 s; a single visible gauge rises and falls. Release selects the cast time, with an audible crest cue.
wizards.normal_cast: Any release after 0.20 s casts normally. Overholding at 0.60 s auto-vents a normal cast; there is no random misfire or self-damage.
wizards.mastery: Release within the marked 100 ms crest window at 0.45 s: direct damage gains 12%. On nondamaging spells, pay 12% less mana instead. One reward per spell.
wizards.signature: Kiln Vent — 14 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.35 s windup. Project a visible 4 m cone that deals 28 thermal damage and pushes enemies 1.5 m. It contributes Heat strength 1 to affected world props; it does not create a persistent fire field.
wizards.passive: Tempered Hands — taking thermal damage grants a visible 20-point shield for 2 s, once per 8 s. It provides no thermal immunity and respects the shared shield cap.
wizards.range_preference: Mid and close range; release timing rewards deliberate peeks.
wizards.weakness: Crest timing is predictable, and the cone requires commitment at short range.
wizards.counterplay: Peek between pressure cues, force an early release, then punish the cone’s windup. Move sideways out of the cone.
wizards.lore: An industrial spellwright who once kept floating foundries aloft.
wizards.visual_identity: Soot-black apron armor, a glowing chest furnace emblem, red pressure bands on the focus.
wizards.audio_identity: A building bellows hiss and a metallic crest ping heard by nearby opponents.

wizards.name: Sera Quill
wizards.title: The Living Script
wizards.casting_mode: Rune tracing: draw a selected spell’s stable three-stroke glyph.
wizards.input_sequence: Tap primary for a guided 0.30 s normal inscription. Hold Cast Modifier to open an explicitly camera-locked rune pane, trace its three strokes, then release primary. Cancel instantly returns view control. Direction-key tracing is equivalent.
wizards.normal_cast: The guided inscription always yields normal output. A manual trace with the right three-stroke order but low shape accuracy also yields normal output; invalid or abandoned strokes do not spend resources.
wizards.mastery: Finish the three strokes within 0.75 s with at least 85% path accuracy and endpoints within 8% of pane width: the spell costs 15% less mana. Shape scoring uses normalized pane coordinates, never raw mouse DPI.
wizards.signature: Revision Seal — 18 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Place a glowing 1.5 m radius floor seal within 8 m for 4 s, 40 health. Any spell projectile crossing it loses 10% speed once, including the caster’s. The seal occupies one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Margin Notes — canceling a prepared spell before commitment restores normal camera control and gives 10 stamina, at most once per 8 s. It never refunds spent spell mana or adds damage.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; favors cover for inscription.
wizards.weakness: Manual glyphs temporarily demand attention away from the battlefield and advertise ink movement.
wizards.counterplay: Pressure the pane window, destroy Revision Seal, and shift position before the completed spell is aimed.
wizards.lore: A court archivist whose forbidden marginalia became physically real.
wizards.visual_identity: Ivory cuffs, floating black script, and gold writing nibs; all glyphs use fixed readable silhouettes.
wizards.audio_identity: Three dry pen strokes and a resonant stamp at commitment.

wizards.name: Oren Vey
wizards.title: The True Utterance
wizards.casting_mode: Spoken syllable cadence with an equivalent rhythm-key language.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary to select the spell’s displayed three-syllable phrase, speak it during the 0.75 s cadence, then release to commit. Alternatively use three rhythm inputs at the same cadence. A normal cast uses the guided cadence with broad 200 ms beat tolerance.
wizards.normal_cast: Recognized selected syllables in order, or the three equivalent keys, cast normally. A recognition failure displays the missing syllable and permits the rhythm alternative; no resource is spent until commitment.
wizards.mastery: Score all three syllables or key taps within 80 ms of their beats: pay 15% less mana. Pronunciation scores only distinguish selected syllables; accent, voice pitch, loudness, and vocal strain never improve damage.
wizards.signature: Hush Verse — 20 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.40 s windup. Fire a visible 18 m/s Sound ring up to 12 m, radius 0.8 m. First enemy hit takes 18 arcane damage and is silenced for 0.4 s, sharing global hard-control immunity. Cover stops the ring.
wizards.passive: Measured Voice — a completed normal or mastered phrase grants 6 stamina once per 4 s. A player can obtain the identical passive using rhythm input.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; values uninterrupted phrases.
wizards.weakness: Every phrase has the same committed duration and an audible opponent-facing chant generated by the game even in key mode.
wizards.counterplay: Use cover during the chant, pressure while syllables are being entered, and dodge Hush Verse’s slow visible ring.
wizards.lore: A linguist reconstructing the words that once held a broken moon together.
wizards.visual_identity: A silver throat clasp, amber phoneme rings, and embroidery resembling sound waves.
wizards.audio_identity: Three unambiguous game-generated syllables; microphone volume never changes the opponent’s cue.

wizards.name: Vexa Noll
wizards.title: The Formula Runner
wizards.casting_mode: Ordered key assembly: a prefix, operator, and closure.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier and enter the selected spell’s fixed three-token sequence using Modifier A, Modifier B, and primary; aim and movement remain live. Tokens are displayed during training and optionally in combat.
wizards.normal_cast: Complete the correct order within 1.2 s, with no beat requirement, then primary commits. A wrong token clears only that token and adds a visible 0.15 s correction delay; no mana is spent.
wizards.mastery: Complete all three tokens within 0.45 s without correction: gain 10% shorter intrinsic spell windup, capped at a 0.06 s reduction. Does not reduce spell cooldown or remove enemy telegraphs.
wizards.signature: Factor Shift — 15 s cooldown, 15 mana, instant. For 3 s, the next spell may be canceled during the first 50% of its intrinsic windup; cancellation consumes 5 mana and starts 25% of its normal cooldown. Normal spell costs are spent only if committed.
wizards.passive: Clean Syntax — after two different normal spell definitions are committed consecutively, the next different spell costs 5% less mana; same-spell repetition breaks the sequence. One bonus per third cast, within efficiency caps.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; fluid offense through changing formulas.
wizards.weakness: Token correction costs time; repeatedly using one safe spell yields no passive benefit.
wizards.counterplay: Interrupt her intended cadence with cover and aggression, then punish an incorrect or canceled preparation.
wizards.lore: A magical compiler engineer who considers dueling a proof of execution.
wizards.visual_identity: Geometric violet coat panels and three rotating punctuation glyphs around the hands.
wizards.audio_identity: A distinct click for each token and a low error tick for corrections.

wizards.name: Cael Argent
wizards.title: The Returnblade
wizards.casting_mode: Parry-triggered casting: turn a timed defense into an empowered spell preparation.
wizards.input_sequence: Primary performs a 0.25 s normal preparation. During a successful common parry, press Cast Modifier within 0.5 s to arm the next selected spell; release primary to cast while manual aim remains required.
wizards.normal_cast: Normal preparation is always available. A failed parry uses the common parry stamina cost and recovery and never disables casting.
wizards.mastery: A parry performed within its final 100 ms success band arms one spell for 2 s: that spell has 12% shorter intrinsic windup. The reward applies once, cannot stack, and does not reflect the spell automatically.
wizards.signature: Argent Lunge — 14 s cooldown, 25 stamina, 0.20 s tell. Dash up to 5 m in the aimed ground direction and make a 2.5 m melee thrust for 35 physical damage. Terrain stops the dash; it has no invulnerability and uses the shared two-dash-charge cap.
wizards.passive: Return Guard — a successful common parry grants 15 shield for 1.5 s, once per 6 s. Shield is awarded after damage prevention resolves and cannot absorb the triggering hit retroactively.
wizards.range_preference: Close range with a midrange countercast.
wizards.weakness: Needs opponents to offer readable attacks, and mistakes consume stamina needed for approach.
wizards.counterplay: Feint windups, use indirect fields, vary attack timing, and step sideways from the lunge tell.
wizards.lore: A disgraced royal bodyguard hunting the spell that killed his charge.
wizards.visual_identity: Polished silver vambraces, a narrow dueling mask, and bright parry sparks.
wizards.audio_identity: A sharp steel note on a parry and a drawn-out scrape before the lunge.

wizards.name: Mira Bell
wizards.title: The Tempo Witch
wizards.casting_mode: Instrument rhythm: build a beat and release on a chosen measure.
wizards.input_sequence: Holding primary starts a visible four-beat staff using eighth-note beats at 120 BPM, 0.25 s apart. Tap Modifier A on two adjacent beats and primary on the following beat to cast. The staff stops after casting; no real instrument is required.
wizards.normal_cast: Three inputs within broad 120 ms beat windows cast normally. The player can use a guided 0.50 s phrase with the same total commitment and normal output. Guidance does not award mastery.
wizards.mastery: Three inputs each within 70 ms of their beats grant 12% lower mana cost. Repeating on additional measures earns no greater bonus and cannot bank multiple casts.
wizards.signature: Offbeat Pulse — 16 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Emit a visible 5 m radius ring for 24 arcane damage; struck enemies suffer a 15% slow for 1.2 s. The ring propagates at 10 m/s, requires sight at impact, and can be outrun or blocked by cover.
wizards.passive: Walking Meter — after two different spell casts at least 0.5 s apart, grant 8 stamina, once per 6 s. Running faster or tapping extra beats grants nothing.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range and mobile close-range disruption.
wizards.weakness: Predictable beats expose launch timing; the ring is weak outside its short reach.
wizards.counterplay: Peek between beats, cross cover during the ring, and make her restart a interrupted phrase.
wizards.lore: An itinerant musician who learned the resonant intervals of stone and flesh.
wizards.visual_identity: Bronze handbells, teal pleated robes, and metronome ticks orbiting the focus.
wizards.audio_identity: A fixed opponent-facing beat count; personal music sliders cannot hide cast cues.

wizards.name: Dain Coil
wizards.title: The Circuit Saint
wizards.casting_mode: Charge routing: connect a source, junction, and destination in a three-node circuit.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier; select one of three displayed junctions with Modifier A/B or primary, then confirm the glowing destination. Aim stays live; the circuit occupies a small fixed HUD corner.
wizards.normal_cast: Any valid source-to-destination route completed within 1 s casts normally. Unconnected routes remain in preparation and spend nothing.
wizards.mastery: Use the shortest two-edge route shown for the selected spell within 0.55 s: gain 15% resource efficiency. The graph changes only when a different spell is selected, never randomly during preparation.
wizards.signature: Ground Lead — 18 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.35 s windup. Place a destructible 35-health rod within 8 m for 5 s. It absorbs up to 40 electrical damage delivered into its 1.5 m radius from either player, then breaks. It never absorbs damage already assigned to a player outside that radius and occupies one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Insulated Step — crossing an explicitly connected electrified wet patch costs 20% less stamina for the next dodge within 2 s, once per 8 s; electrical damage is still taken normally.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; rewards readable reaction terrain.
wizards.weakness: Routing attention competes with aiming, and his rod has no protection against other channels.
wizards.counterplay: Attack from mixed channels, destroy the rod with physical hits, and force a route correction through sudden pressure.
wizards.lore: A storm-chapel electrician who rewired ceremonial lightning into practical tools.
wizards.visual_identity: Copper circuit embroidery, dark rubber-like gauntlets, and branching node lights.
wizards.audio_identity: Relay clicks during routing and a crackling destination snap.

wizards.name: Nessa Vale
wizards.title: The Surveyor
wizards.casting_mode: Sigil geometry: place three vertices and close a stable shape.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier to display a three-vertex local sigil pane. Place its vertices with three taps while the pane explicitly holds the camera; release to resume aim and primary commits. Equivalent three direction-key selections use the same pane and commitment.
wizards.normal_cast: Any non-self-crossing triangle completed within 1.2 s casts normally. The resulting world spell still launches from the caster’s usual origin and uses the normal range.
wizards.mastery: Match the shown area within 10% and the longest edge within 10%, in at most 0.75 s: a nondamaging spell costs 15% less mana; a damaging spell gains 10% projectile speed. At most one reward.
wizards.signature: Survey Wall — 18 s cooldown, 30 mana, 0.50 s windup. Raise a 2 m wide, 1.3 m tall, 50-health Earth parapet within 6 m for 4 s. It blocks projectiles and movement, cannot spawn intersecting a player, and occupies one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Measured Ground — while within 2 m of a destructible construct she created, receive 5% physical damage reduction. Multiple constructs do not stack; total damage-reduction cap still applies.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range and deliberate terrain fighting.
wizards.weakness: Geometric casting has a clearly signaled attention window; small parapets offer limited cover.
wizards.counterplay: Flank or jump the parapet, destroy it, and pressure during vertex placement.
wizards.lore: A bridge architect who draws load-bearing spells in the air.
wizards.visual_identity: Ochre surveyor sash, folding calipers, and white edge-length annotations visible only to her.
wizards.audio_identity: Three chalk taps followed by a deep closure chord.

wizards.name: Halen Tide
wizards.title: The Breathless Diver
wizards.casting_mode: Pressure metering: maintain a virtual breath gauge with alternating compression and vent.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary to compress the gauge; Modifier A vents it. Release primary between 0.30 and 0.90 s to cast. This is a game meter, with no microphone, lung capacity, or breath holding requirement.
wizards.normal_cast: Any release in the safe 20–80 pressure band casts normally. Leaving the band automatically vents and offers a normal cast after 0.30 s; mana is spent only on that cast.
wizards.mastery: Keep pressure within 45–55 for a continuous 0.25 s before release: pay 15% less mana. Faster toggling than the 0.1 s accepted input interval adds no benefit.
wizards.signature: Undertow Mantle — 17 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.25 s windup. Create a neutral 2 m radius Water eddy centered at the cast location for 3 s. Enemies and caster within it are slowed 15%; each body takes only 12 arcane damage on first entry. Water strength 1; one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Pressure Reserve — after spending at least 30 mana on one committed spell, gain 10 stamina, once per 6 s. Refunds and subsequent reaction costs cannot retrigger it.
wizards.range_preference: Mid and close range; likes paths through water.
wizards.weakness: Pressure maintenance consumes attention, and the eddy hinders him as well.
wizards.counterplay: Change angles while his meter is stable, attack from outside the eddy, and use Heat or Frost to alter its water.
wizards.lore: A wreck diver who maps the currents under drowned cities.
wizards.visual_identity: Weighted diving mantle, blue pressure tubes, and rippling circular gauge.
wizards.audio_identity: A low compression hum with a crisp hiss on vent.

wizards.name: Tess Meridian
wizards.title: The Pendulum Judge
wizards.casting_mode: Phase selection: a moving pendulum crosses attack, utility, and guard sectors.
wizards.input_sequence: Primary starts a 0.60 s pendulum sweep; primary again commits in the sector matching the selected spell’s displayed function. Modifier A stops the sweep for a normal 0.30 s cast if timing is undesirable.
wizards.normal_cast: Any second press casts normally; stopping the sweep also casts normally. Function tags are fixed in each spell record, and no hidden random sector exists.
wizards.mastery: Commit within the matching sector’s 100 ms central window: attacking spells gain 10% direct damage; utility or defensive spells cost 15% less mana. One reward, determined by selected spell function.
wizards.signature: Stay of Motion — 19 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.40 s windup. Shoot a visible 16 m/s Gravity bead up to 10 m. First target hit takes 20 arcane damage and receives a 20% slow for 1.5 s. The bead is blocked by cover and has no homing.
wizards.passive: Second Opinion — after a missed direct projectile spell, receive 5 mana once per 8 s, limited to 25% of that spell’s paid cost. Multi-projectile casts count as missed only if all miss.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range with measured defensive pauses.
wizards.weakness: Sector timing narrows launch opportunities; the miss refund is too small to support deliberate spam.
wizards.counterplay: Offer fleeting sightlines and dodge the slow Gravity bead; attack between matching phase windows.
wizards.lore: A civil judge who became convinced gravity was the only honest witness.
wizards.visual_identity: Black judicial sleeves, pale gold pendulum weights, and a visible rotating sector dial.
wizards.audio_identity: One ticking sweep and a heavy click for the selected sector.

wizards.name: Rook Sable
wizards.title: The Alternating Current
wizards.casting_mode: Polarity alternation: cast by opening and closing opposite hand charges.
wizards.input_sequence: Tap Modifier A or B to open a positive or negative charge, then primary closes it after 0.25 s. Opening the opposite sign on the next cast continues the alternation; same-sign repetition remains valid.
wizards.normal_cast: Either sign casts the selected spell normally after the 0.25 s preparation. The sign changes only the visible hand state, not damage school or target allegiance.
wizards.mastery: Alternate opening signs across three committed casts, with each closure within 100 ms of its 0.35 s cue: the third spell costs 15% less mana. Pattern resets after that reward or after 4 s without a cast.
wizards.signature: Cross Current — 15 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Create two visible Force plates 3 m apart within 6 m for 2 s. Crossing the line between them pushes any body 1 m perpendicular once per body; deals no damage. One field allocation; plates each have 25 health.
wizards.passive: Balanced Load — after casting three different spell definitions consecutively, gain 12 shield for 2 s, once per 7 s. School variety is optional; exact spell repetition resets the sequence.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range with short displacement traps.
wizards.weakness: Alternation rewards sustained casting but makes hands and rhythm readable.
wizards.counterplay: Force gaps longer than 4 s, cross the plates only after breaking one, or exploit the brief shield duration.
wizards.lore: A former power-grid saboteur who refuses to let one current rule the world.
wizards.visual_identity: Asymmetric white and black gloves, alternating bright hand motes, and heavy work boots.
wizards.audio_identity: Distinct rising and falling electrical-like tones, without changing the spell’s damage cue.

wizards.name: Liora Thread
wizards.title: The Anchorwitch
wizards.casting_mode: Tether geometry: prepare a spell while maintaining distance to a declared anchor.
wizards.input_sequence: Tap Cast Modifier to place a harmless visible anchor on nearby ground within 6 m; primary begins a 0.30 s tether preparation. Move while aiming to adjust the displayed anchor distance, then release primary. One anchor only; 6 s lifetime.
wizards.normal_cast: Any release casts normally, even outside the anchor band. With no anchor, primary uses an ordinary 0.30 s preparation.
wizards.mastery: Remain 2–4 m from the anchor and keep the tether unbroken by cover for the final 0.30 s: gain 12% lower mana cost. Range is checked server-side and does not extend spell reach.
wizards.signature: Snapline — 16 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Attach a visible line to the first enemy hit by a 20 m/s projectile within 10 m for 1.5 s. If the line stays unobstructed, the target is slowed 15%; line breaks past 10 m or on solid cover. No pull and no reveal through walls.
wizards.passive: Sure Footing — while inside the 2–4 m anchor band, common dodge costs 5 less stamina, once per 5 s. The anchor is nonphysical and supplies no shield or sight information.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; orbits an announced fighting position.
wizards.weakness: An anchor advertises preferred positioning, and cover can break the mastery tether.
wizards.counterplay: Move beyond her anchor band, contest its perimeter, and break Snapline using terrain.
wizards.lore: A wandering seamstress repairs tears in geography with visible thread.
wizards.visual_identity: Moss-green ribbons, sewing shuttles, and a taut luminous line to an open ground knot.
wizards.audio_identity: A thread-pluck when entering the band and a dry snap when cover breaks a line.

wizards.name: Fen Skystep
wizards.title: The Footwork Adept
wizards.casting_mode: Directional footwork: two meaningful movement changes form a cast pattern.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary during two chosen movement-direction changes, then release. A direction counts only after moving at least 0.5 m, so vibrating movement keys does nothing. Sprint and camera aim remain normal.
wizards.normal_cast: Release after one qualifying step or after a 0.35 s guided preparation for normal output. Jumping is never required for a normal cast.
wizards.mastery: Complete a forward-to-sideways or sideways-to-backward pattern within 0.9 s while traveling at least 1.5 m: the spell gains 12% projectile speed, or pays 12% less mana if nonprojectile. Terrain collisions invalidate only the reward.
wizards.signature: Slipstream Cut — 14 s cooldown, 25 stamina, 0.20 s tell. Dash 4 m sideways and leave a neutral 1.5 m wide wind corridor for 2 s. Projectiles crossing it deflect 5 degrees in its visible arrow direction once. No damage or invulnerability; one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Light Landing — landing after a normal jump restores 5 stamina if at least 1 m horizontal travel occurred, once per 5 s. It cannot restore more than the jump’s paid cost.
wizards.range_preference: Close and mid range; constantly changes angles.
wizards.weakness: Mastery requires space and exposes travel direction; narrow terrain constrains footwork.
wizards.counterplay: Fight beside walls and on broken footing, aim ahead of the required second step, and avoid shooting across the wind arrow.
wizards.lore: A skybridge courier who learned to cast without stopping deliveries.
wizards.visual_identity: Short white scarf, pale cyan foot traces, and feather-shaped focus fittings.
wizards.audio_identity: Two distinct shoe taps followed by a rushing release.

wizards.name: Edda Flint
wizards.title: The Spellblade
wizards.casting_mode: Hit-confirm weaving: place a spell between two common weapon actions.
wizards.input_sequence: Primary casts with a 0.25 s normal preparation. After a common melee hit or successful melee parry, hold Cast Modifier and release primary within 0.6 s to weave the selected spell. Weapons use the shared melee profile.
wizards.normal_cast: All spells can be cast normally with no weapon contact. A missed melee attempt grants no weave reward but does not lock the spell.
wizards.mastery: Confirm a melee hit, commit one spell within 0.6 s, then complete the windup of a different melee action within 0.6 s of that spell: arm one next spell for 2 s with 12% direct damage, or 12% mana efficiency if nondamaging. The armed reward applies only to that next spell; it never changes a hit retroactively. A completed follow-up can miss, but canceled windups do not qualify.
wizards.signature: Flint Sweep — 13 s cooldown, 30 stamina, 0.30 s windup. Swing a visible 100-degree arc at 2.5 m for 40 physical damage and push targets 0.8 m. No cleave beyond the arc and no invulnerability; it can be parried using the common rules.
wizards.passive: Battle Tuition — a direct melee hit restores 4 mana once per 1.5 s; secondary damage cannot trigger it. At most 12 mana restored over any 5 s interval.
wizards.range_preference: Close range with spells used to support engagement.
wizards.weakness: The full weave needs two melee commitments and is vulnerable to retreats and parries.
wizards.counterplay: Keep outside 2.5 m, bait the first swing, break the follow-up timing, and punish the sweep’s recovery.
wizards.lore: A battlefield instructor whose students learned that every spell needs a place in a fight.
wizards.visual_identity: Practical iron coat, amber blade marks, and a focus guard shaped like a training sword.
wizards.audio_identity: A low impact note followed by a bright weave confirmation chime.

wizards.name: Asha Prism
wizards.title: The Threefold Regent
wizards.casting_mode: Stance grammar: route each spell through one of three clearly visible attitudes.
wizards.input_sequence: Cast Modifier cycles Reach, Shelter, and Motion; primary commits after a 0.25 s stance settling time. The selected spell’s icon shows its compatible mastery attitude; every attitude can cast every spell normally.
wizards.normal_cast: After settling, any attitude gives the normal spell. Stances do not alter aim, school, resistances, or spell slots.
wizards.mastery: Choose Reach for a direct projectile, Shelter for a defensive spell, or Motion for a movement/utility spell, then settle 0.35 s without changing stance: gain respectively 10% projectile speed, 12% mana efficiency, or 12% stamina efficiency on that spell. Only one category applies.
wizards.signature: Prismatic Pivot — 17 s cooldown, 20 mana, instant. Change stance immediately and gain a 25-point shield for 1.5 s. The shield has a visible shimmer and remains within the common cap.
wizards.passive: Regent’s Pace — changing to a different stance after casting two different spells grants 5% movement speed for 1.5 s, once per 7 s. It respects the +20% movement cap.
wizards.range_preference: Flexible mid range; every attitude can execute any of her eight spells.
wizards.weakness: Her visible stance predicts intended spell function; repeated switches delay preparation.
wizards.counterplay: Punish stance transitions, attack after Pivot’s shield expires, and force her into the wrong functional stance.
wizards.lore: An heir trained in three rival academies whose methods she refuses to separate.
wizards.visual_identity: Three-panel violet, white, and gold mantle with a stance-specific overhead crest.
wizards.audio_identity: A three-note chord whose prominent note identifies the current stance.

wizards.name: Ysolde Echo
wizards.title: The Mnemonic
wizards.casting_mode: Memory reproduction: replay a short visible motif after it fades.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier to show a fixed three-symbol motif for the selected spell for 0.30 s; reproduce its three positions using A/B/primary, then commit. Aim and movement stay live.
wizards.normal_cast: A permanently visible motif accessibility preset permits normal output. Correct reproduction within 1.5 s also casts normally. A mistake reveals the motif for a 0.20 s correction instead of consuming mana.
wizards.mastery: Reproduce the motif from memory in 0.50 s after the preview, without correction: reduce mana cost 15%. Motifs remain fixed per spell across the match; randomized memory puzzles never appear.
wizards.signature: Memory Lantern — 18 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.35 s windup. Place a 30-health visible lantern within 6 m for 4 s. Within 3 m and clear sight, it outlines an enemy who committed a spell there in the last 0.5 s for 1 s; it cannot reveal through cover or steam. One field allocation.
wizards.passive: Recall Discipline — equipping a spell used in an earlier round grants 10 maximum mana for the current round, once per round and capped at +10. Default spells qualify only after they were actually cast in a previous round.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; excels with familiar spell libraries.
wizards.weakness: Memory rewards comfort but correction delays punish rushed mistakes; lantern information has strict sight requirements.
wizards.counterplay: Pressure the reproduction window and destroy the lantern or move behind cover before its outline.
wizards.lore: A keeper of endangered memories trying to save an academy erased from history.
wizards.visual_identity: Pearl memory beads, soft blue ghost script, and a lantern filled with moving names.
wizards.audio_identity: Three soft mnemonic tones and an unmistakable correction rustle.

wizards.name: Marek Hour
wizards.title: The Delayed Hand
wizards.casting_mode: Scheduled release: choose a near-future launch time and keep a cancellable cast pending.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier and select 0.30, 0.50, or 0.70 s with A/B/primary. Primary schedules the selected spell; continue aiming until the visible countdown ends. Cancel before the final 0.10 s spends nothing.
wizards.normal_cast: The scheduled cast launches normally when the timer ends. A normal primary cast uses a 0.30 s schedule. Spells launch from the caster’s position at release, never from a past position.
wizards.mastery: Tap primary again within 75 ms of the selected release time to confirm: gain 12% lower mana cost. Missing confirmation still releases normally. Only one pending cast; swapping spells cancels it.
wizards.signature: Borrowed Moment — 21 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.25 s windup. For 2 s, one pending spell may have its schedule extended by 0.30 s once; extension is visibly telegraphed. On eventual release grant 20 shield for 1 s. No attack rewind or time freeze.
wizards.passive: Patient Motion — completing a scheduled cast while moving at walking speed or below restores 5 stamina, once per 5 s. Sprinting during the schedule removes only the passive.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; timed peeks and delayed threats.
wizards.weakness: Cannot fire immediately while a schedule is pending; opponents hear the countdown.
wizards.counterplay: Move or take cover just before release, rush during a long schedule, and bait extensions before attacking.
wizards.lore: A clockmaker who permits himself to borrow fractions of a second, never whole lives.
wizards.visual_identity: A fractured pocket clock, charcoal long coat, and a visible countdown ring around the hand.
wizards.audio_identity: Audible winding ticks accelerating toward launch; extension adds a distinct extra tick.

wizards.name: Pella Orbit
wizards.title: The Mote Shepherd
wizards.casting_mode: Orbit catching: intercept a virtual preparation mote as it passes a designated socket.
wizards.input_sequence: Primary begins a 0.50 s clockwise mote orbit around a fixed HUD ring. Press Modifier A to catch at the upper socket, then release primary to aim and commit. The mote is a control widget, not a damage summon.
wizards.normal_cast: Catch anywhere in the upper half of the ring for normal output; primary alone performs a guided normal catch at 0.50 s. No world target is chosen by the widget.
wizards.mastery: Catch inside the 80 ms socket window and release within 0.20 s: gain 12% projectile speed, or 12% mana efficiency for nonprojectiles. Catch rewards cannot be banked past that release window.
wizards.signature: Orbital Guard — 17 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.35 s windup. Summon one visible 35-health mote for 3 s that follows 0.75 m from the caster and intercepts the first incoming projectile within 0.3 m of itself, absorbing up to 35 damage then vanishing. Counts toward the two-summon cap and cannot intercept hitscan.
wizards.passive: Gathered Bearings — manually catching three preparation motes across separate casts grants 10 stamina once per 6 s; guided catches count as normal casts but do not qualify.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range with brief directional projectile protection.
wizards.weakness: Orbital Guard protects only its visible side; mastery delays release until the socket passes.
wizards.counterplay: Attack the unguarded angle, use hitscan or melee, and change position at the expected catch timing.
wizards.lore: A shepherd from a valley where lost stars fall small enough to carry.
wizards.visual_identity: Indigo wool cloak, pale orbital lines, and softly glowing star motes.
wizards.audio_identity: A circling crystalline arpeggio and a single catch click.

wizards.name: Tarin Loom
wizards.title: The Threadwright
wizards.casting_mode: Channel weaving: interleave two held inputs without letting either thread slack.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary for the warp; press and hold Modifier A for the weft, release A, then release primary. A small two-thread display shows the required crossing. Aim and locomotion stay active.
wizards.normal_cast: Complete one overlap lasting 0.10–0.60 s for normal output. The guided preset reproduces the overlap with two discrete taps and the same 0.40 s exposure.
wizards.mastery: Begin the weft 0.15–0.25 s after the warp and hold both for 0.20–0.30 s: pay 15% less mana. Extra crosses or faster inputs do not increase the benefit.
wizards.signature: Binding Weft — 18 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.40 s windup. Lay a visible 4 m by 1 m Growth thread strip on reachable ground within 8 m for 4 s, 35 health. Each body crossing it is slowed 20% for 1 s; effects refresh rather than stack. One field allocation, no hard root.
wizards.passive: Tension Sense — damage to one of his visible player-created constructs grants 8 stamina once per 6 s. Destruction by lifetime expiry and self-damage do not qualify.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; prepares contested crossing routes.
wizards.weakness: Two-channel attention and exposed ground strips limit spontaneous aggression.
wizards.counterplay: Destroy the strip, jump across its footprint, and pressure while both inputs are held.
wizards.lore: A carpet-maker whose tapestries once supported refugees across a canyon.
wizards.visual_identity: Rust-red woven sleeves, long shuttle focus, and crossed green and amber spell threads.
wizards.audio_identity: A soft shuttle slide, a tension hum during overlap, and a cloth snap on release.

wizards.name: Sel Nyx
wizards.title: The Harmonic Tuner
wizards.casting_mode: Frequency tuning: adjust a continuous dial against a stable reference.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary to display the spell’s fixed reference tone and dial; use two remappable tuning inputs or mouse wheel increments to tune, then release. Wheel tuning is active only while the modifier is held and never changes equipment.
wizards.normal_cast: Release after 0.30 s at any dial position for normal output. An always-on reference visualization permits play with audio off.
wizards.mastery: Match the dial within 3% of the reference and hold it there for 0.20 s, within a 0.80 s preparation: gain 10% direct damage, or 15% mana efficiency on nondamaging spells. Each spell has a persistent reference value.
wizards.signature: Resonance Break — 19 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.35 s windup. A visible 6 m cone deals 20 arcane damage to bodies and 40 damage to destructible constructs. It does not damage immutable map structure or multiply normal spells’ damage to props.
wizards.passive: Fine Adjustment — completing a normal or mastered dial cast after taking no damage for 1 s grants 10 shield for 1.5 s, once per 6 s.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range and anti-construct skirmishing.
wizards.weakness: Tuning attention and a short cone make her vulnerable to fast flanks.
wizards.counterplay: Apply small damage during setup to deny her shield, attack from outside 6 m, and spread constructs so one cone cannot catch all.
wizards.lore: A bellfounder who can hear when matter is about to disagree with itself.
wizards.visual_identity: Dark plum coat, tuning-fork focus, and a visible waveform with a reference notch.
wizards.audio_identity: A reference hum plus a beating interference sound that resolves into one pitch.

wizards.name: Juno Twinhand
wizards.title: The Chordwright
wizards.casting_mode: Two-hand chords: select and hold a pair of logical hand signs together.
wizards.input_sequence: Cast Modifier displays one of three fixed two-input chords for the selected spell. Press its two logical inputs within 0.20 s of each other, hold 0.20 s, then primary commits. A single remappable chord selector can emulate the pair with identical commitment.
wizards.normal_cast: Any recognized chord held for 0.20 s casts normally. The one-input accessibility chord maintains the same hold time and visible two-hand telegraph.
wizards.mastery: Choose the displayed matching chord, start both logical inputs within 60 ms, and release within the indicated 100 ms window: pay 15% less mana. Accessibility mode uses a three-position selector confirmation scored with the same 60 ms timing requirement.
wizards.signature: Twin Ward — 18 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.30 s windup. Gain two visible 15-point shield layers for 2 s; first covers frontal hits and second covers rear hits as measured by damage-source direction. Side hits split between layers. Maximum total shield contribution is 30.
wizards.passive: Ambidextrous Recovery — after committing two different spells with different chords, regain 8 stamina, once per 6 s. A spell’s chord label remains fixed for the match.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; balanced guard and flexible casting.
wizards.weakness: Chord holds briefly bind input attention; each ward layer is small and directional.
wizards.counterplay: Force repeated same-function casts, attack a depleted side, and time pressure during chord holds.
wizards.lore: A temple sculptor who learned spell signs from statues with too many hands.
wizards.visual_identity: Two differently colored sleeves, symmetrical focus brackets, and paired hand-glyph light.
wizards.audio_identity: Two simultaneous notes with a distinctive timing-flam when inputs are staggered.

wizards.name: Moth Iri
wizards.title: The Puzzlekeeper
wizards.casting_mode: Tile transposition: restore a small two-by-two sigil by one meaningful swap.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier to display four tiles; select two tiles using a four-way remappable input, swap them, then primary commits. The selected spell always uses the same initial and solved layout.
wizards.normal_cast: The first legal swap casts normally after 0.40 s even if it does not solve the layout. Guided mode highlights the legal swap but provides only normal output.
wizards.mastery: Restore the exact two-by-two arrangement with the single correct swap within 0.60 s: pay 15% less mana. Extra swaps grant no reward and restart preparation; this is a compact recognition task, not a randomized sliding puzzle.
wizards.signature: False Door — 20 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.40 s windup. Place a visible, shimmer-edged 1.5 m by 2 m illusion panel within 6 m for 3 s, 25 health. It blocks ordinary sight but not movement, sound, or projectiles; silhouette is visible within 4 m. One field allocation, no player impersonation.
wizards.passive: Solved Margin — mastering two different tile layouts grants 12 shield for 2 s, once per 8 s. Repeating one solved layout does not qualify.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; uses temporary sight breaks.
wizards.weakness: Tile inspection splits attention; the illusion cannot stop incoming attacks.
wizards.counterplay: Shoot through False Door, close within silhouette distance, and change position while she selects tiles.
wizards.lore: A crypt-door custodian who protects answers by rearranging their questions.
wizards.visual_identity: Patchwork charcoal shawl, four square jade tiles, and sharply edged purple illusions.
wizards.audio_identity: Stone tile clicks and a hollow latch sound when a layout is restored.

wizards.name: Ivo Cistern
wizards.title: The Reservoir
wizards.casting_mode: Packet division: fill a measured vessel with discrete resource packets.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier and add 1-unit or 3-unit packets with A/B toward the selected spell’s displayed 4–7 unit target; primary releases. Units are a preparation widget, not extra stored mana.
wizards.normal_cast: Any vessel with at least one packet releases normal output after 0.30 s. Overfilling vents cosmetic excess and still yields normal output; actual mana cost remains the spell’s defined cost.
wizards.mastery: Reach the exact vessel target using the minimum displayed packet count within 0.65 s: pay 15% less mana. Targets are fixed per spell and extra packet taps never add damage.
wizards.signature: Reserve Decant — 22 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.40 s windup. Create a visible 30-health reservoir at the caster’s feet for 3 s; if the caster remains within 2 m for 1 s, restore 15 mana once. It restores no more than 25% of mana spent on spells in the previous 5 s, so reserve use cannot create net mana from an empty history. One field allocation.
wizards.passive: Full Vessel — at 80 mana or more, the first committed spell after 3 s without casting gains 10% projectile speed, or a 5 mana cost reduction for nonprojectiles subject to the 20% efficiency cap.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; controlled bursts followed by repositioning.
wizards.weakness: Reserve Decant announces a stationary recovery point and provides a small bounded return.
wizards.counterplay: Force early low-mana trades, attack the reservoir or displace him from it, and capitalize after the full-vessel opening.
wizards.lore: A desert water accountant who measures magical abundance by what remains afterward.
wizards.visual_identity: Ceramic vessel belt, pale blue linen, and marked translucent preparation flasks.
wizards.audio_identity: Distinct packet drips and a measured pouring sound at release.

wizards.name: Venn Needle
wizards.title: The Mark Painter
wizards.casting_mode: Reticle painting: trace a visible aim pattern over a fixed distance guide.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary to display three faint reticle checkpoints around the current aim origin; move the aim through them and release. The pattern moves with the caster but never attaches to or reveals an enemy.
wizards.normal_cast: Release after 0.25 s or passing any checkpoint for normal output. The normal reticle remains visible, camera motion stays fully controlled, and aim assist is never added.
wizards.mastery: Pass all three checkpoints in order within 0.60 s and finish within 1.5 degrees of the initial aim direction: gain 12% direct damage on the next manually aimed direct spell. Persistent-field and summon spells instead cost 12% less mana.
wizards.signature: Needle Brand — 17 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Fire an 28 m/s Metal needle up to 18 m for 22 physical damage. A hit produces a 1.5 s visible mark only while the marked enemy is in clear sight; subsequent direct weapon hit during that window adds 8 physical damage once. Cover and concealment hide the mark.
wizards.passive: Fine Point — directly hitting a destructible construct with a projectile grants 5 mana once per 7 s, capped at 25% of that projectile’s paid mana; secondary damage cannot qualify.
wizards.range_preference: Long and mid range; precise deliberate shots.
wizards.weakness: Painting introduces a visible aim excursion, and the mark offers no hidden tracking.
wizards.counterplay: Move when the reticle returns to origin, use cover during the mark window, and rush between careful shots.
wizards.lore: A tailor of enchanted armor who knows every seam and fastening.
wizards.visual_identity: A dark fitted waistcoat, needle-shaped focus, and small red stitched reticle marks.
wizards.audio_identity: Three light needle ticks and a taut thread ping on a successful brand.

wizards.name: Sovia Balance
wizards.title: The Counterweight
wizards.casting_mode: Ratio balancing: assign two different weights to equalize a scale.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier to show a selected spell’s fixed weight ratio; A adds a light counterweight and B a heavy one. Primary commits after 0.35 s. The screen-corner scale never steers the camera.
wizards.normal_cast: Any nonempty scale gives normal output. Resetting the scale costs only 0.10 s preparation and no mana.
wizards.mastery: Balance the scale within 5% using at most three inputs within 0.65 s: pay 15% less mana. The challenge is choosing a ratio, unlike Ivo’s exact packet total; repeated inputs beyond three yield normal output only.
wizards.signature: Counterweight Drop — 18 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.45 s windup. Mark a visible 1.5 m radius reachable ground disk within 8 m, then after 0.5 s drop a weight for 32 arcane damage and a 1 m outward push. Cover blocks ground selection; no target following after marking.
wizards.passive: Even Exchange — after taking at least 30 direct damage from one hit, gain 15 stamina once per 8 s. Damage over time and self-damage do not qualify.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range with telegraphed ground pressure.
wizards.weakness: Scale input competes with combat awareness, and the drop gives a long escape cue.
wizards.counterplay: Move off the marked disk, deny clean ratio preparation with aggression, and avoid feeding the passive with isolated large hits when a mixed approach is available.
wizards.lore: A quarry forewoman who settled labor disputes with measured equal force.
wizards.visual_identity: Broad sandstone pauldrons, two hanging brass weights, and a pale balance beam.
wizards.audio_identity: Weight clicks and a descending stone whistle before impact.

wizards.name: Petr Moss
wizards.title: The Groundscript
wizards.casting_mode: Surface contact: draw casting power from an explicitly sampled nearby surface.
wizards.input_sequence: Cast Modifier samples the solid floor beneath the caster over 0.25 s; primary commits while standing, walking, or crouching. Samples are neutral preparation marks, expire after 2 s, and do not create destructible geometry.
wizards.normal_cast: Cast normally from any supported ground; airborne primary performs a 0.35 s self-supported normal preparation instead. All eight of Petr’s spells remain usable in the air.
wizards.mastery: Sample while moving under 2 m/s, then commit before leaving a 1 m radius around the sample: pay 15% less mana. Wet, dry, and frozen floors change presentation only; none gives a free numeric multiplier.
wizards.signature: Root Brace — 16 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. For 2 s gain 15% resistance to displacement distance and 5% physical damage reduction while feet remain grounded; movement speed is reduced 10%. It does not prevent hard control, and all reduction caps apply.
wizards.passive: Earth Recall — landing after at least 0.5 s airborne grants 12 shield for 1.5 s, once per 7 s. Normal jumps can qualify, but repeated micro-hops below the threshold cannot.
wizards.range_preference: Close and mid range; strong on stable ground.
wizards.weakness: Mastery ties him to a small sampled area; Brace reduces his mobility and ends if airborne.
wizards.counterplay: Use vertical attacks and displacement, pressure his sample location, and force him off ledges or onto changing cover.
wizards.lore: A boundary gardener charged with keeping living roads from swallowing villages.
wizards.visual_identity: Moss-covered slate cuffs, heavy bare-looking stone boots, and glowing sole runes.
wizards.audio_identity: A low stone rub on sample and a root-creak during Brace.

wizards.name: Adri Parallax
wizards.title: The Future Archer
wizards.casting_mode: Prediction alignment: place an aim point, then confirm the expected future aim.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold primary to record the current manual aim vector; aim freely for 0.40 s and release. A private guide shows the original vector plus the caster’s chosen offset; it never calculates an enemy trajectory.
wizards.normal_cast: Release anywhere after 0.25 s for normal output from the current reticle. The guide supplies no target selection, wall information, or auto-leading.
wizards.mastery: At preparation start select one of three offset sockets, then finish within 1.5 degrees of that socket after 0.40–0.55 s: gain 12% projectile speed; nonprojectiles gain 12% mana efficiency. Mastery measures planned aim relocation, not whether an opponent happened to stand there.
wizards.signature: Parallax Feint — 18 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.25 s windup. Leave a clearly translucent stationary silhouette at the current position for 1.5 s, 20 health, and move up to 3 m sideways in a visible dash. No invulnerability; silhouette cannot cast, damage, or hide nearby bodies. Counts as one summon.
wizards.passive: Lead Foot — after a direct projectile travels at least 12 m and hits a player, restore 6 stamina, once per 5 s. Reaction and secondary hits do not qualify.
wizards.range_preference: Long range with planned lateral peeks.
wizards.weakness: The planned offset constrains spontaneous aiming, and the silhouette is openly recognizable as a decoy.
wizards.counterplay: Change direction after her preparation begins, close inside 12 m, and follow the visible dash rather than firing at the silhouette.
wizards.lore: A caravan outrider who trained to shoot where wind would carry the next threat.
wizards.visual_identity: A pale sand scarf, amber parallax brackets, and elongated bowlike focus fins.
wizards.audio_identity: A two-stage sand rattle followed by a high release whistle.

wizards.name: Renn Vector
wizards.title: The Momentum Sage
wizards.casting_mode: Velocity alignment: match a declared movement vector at spell release.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier to declare forward, backward, left, or right velocity using one movement tap; primary prepares for 0.30 s while movement remains live, then release to cast.
wizards.normal_cast: Any release casts normally. Standing still is always permitted and grants no mastery reward. Actual world velocity, not key repetition, determines qualification.
wizards.mastery: Release while moving at least 4 m/s within 20 degrees of the declared horizontal vector, sustained for 0.25 s: gain 12% projectile speed or 12% mana efficiency for nonprojectiles. Sprinting does not increase the bonus.
wizards.signature: Vector Reversal — 15 s cooldown, 25 stamina, 0.20 s tell. Dash up to 4 m opposite current horizontal movement; standing still defaults to the backward aim direction. No invulnerability, no speed banking, and shared dash cap applies.
wizards.passive: Carried Intent — after moving at least 6 m without a direction reversal, the next spell costs 5% less mana, once per 5 s. Travel caused by knockback, teleport, or dash does not count.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range with sustained lateral motion.
wizards.weakness: Vector mastery is telegraphed by committed travel and performs poorly in cramped corners.
wizards.counterplay: Lead shots along his declared run, force reversals with cover, and punish the fixed reverse dash.
wizards.lore: An engineer of moving cities who distrusts magic that demands standing still.
wizards.visual_identity: Orange kinetic bands, slanted silver coat lines, and a clearly oriented arrow at the casting hand.
wizards.audio_identity: A rising air tone during qualifying travel and a short braking sound on reversal.

wizards.name: Anwen Circle
wizards.title: The Ritual Walker
wizards.casting_mode: World ritual traversal: step through two visible ground marks before casting.
wizards.input_sequence: Cast Modifier lays two harmless 0.5 m ground marks at reachable positions 1 m apart near the caster for 3 s. Walk through them in displayed order, then primary commits. Marks cannot cross solid cover or create an inaccessible path.
wizards.normal_cast: Primary alone casts normally after 0.35 s. Walking through one mark and committing also gives normal output. Marks require no mana and have no collision or reaction strength.
wizards.mastery: Traverse both marks within 0.9 s and cast within 0.25 s of the second: pay 15% less mana. Teleporting or being knocked across marks does not qualify; path is chosen by the caster’s aim.
wizards.signature: Circle of Return — 21 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.40 s windup. Place a visible 40-health return circle at current ground position for 3 s. Re-activate once to teleport back if within 6 m and destination clear; the circle shatters if blocked or destroyed. No invulnerability; teleport uses global cap. One field allocation.
wizards.passive: Pilgrim’s Rest — completing a ritual traversal grants 8 stamina once per 6 s, including normal one-mark traversal. No passive health regeneration.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range with planned retreats.
wizards.weakness: Both ritual path and return destination are public and can be contested.
wizards.counterplay: Aim along the marks, destroy the return circle, or stand near its destination to punish return.
wizards.lore: A shrine pilgrim who carries her route home in a portable circle.
wizards.visual_identity: White traveling cloak, vermilion walking staff ornaments, and bright ground footprints.
wizards.audio_identity: Two ceremonial foot tones and a bell at return-circle reactivation.

wizards.name: Korr Etch
wizards.title: The Airsmith
wizards.casting_mode: Kinetic engraving: deliberate weapon-shaped arcs inscribe a spell without requiring a hit.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier and use the normal melee-direction selection to choose horizontal or vertical air cuts; perform two 0.20 s non-damaging inscription cuts, then primary commits. Inscription cuts have visible hand motion and do not secretly become melee attacks.
wizards.normal_cast: Any two cuts cast normally. A guided one-cut normal preparation takes 0.35 s. Weapon category changes appearance only; all focuses can inscribe.
wizards.mastery: Choose the selected spell’s fixed perpendicular cut pair and reverse each exactly within its 100 ms endpoint cue: gain 12% direct damage, or 12% mana efficiency for nondamaging spells. Cuts consume no stamina because they cause no attack.
wizards.signature: Etched Guard — 17 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Raise a visible frontal 1.2 m disc for 1.5 s that absorbs 30 projectile damage. It follows aim but slows turning rate only for the disc, not the camera; fast turns leave it temporarily behind. No full immunity; one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Working Stroke — after a direct common weapon hit, the next normal inscription preparation is 0.10 s shorter, once per 5 s. It does not increase mastered damage or reduce a spell’s own windup.
wizards.range_preference: Close and mid range; control through deliberate hand arcs.
wizards.weakness: Inscription gestures advertise release and cannot defend or damage while they are being made.
wizards.counterplay: Rush during air cuts, attack behind the lagging disc, and use melee to bypass projectile-only protection.
wizards.lore: A smith who carves temporary laws into the air before they cool.
wizards.visual_identity: Heavy charcoal gloves, etched brass sleeves, and square sparks following hand arcs.
wizards.audio_identity: Two rasping engraving strokes and a bright cooling ping.

wizards.name: Vela Red
wizards.title: The Living Covenant
wizards.casting_mode: Vitality commitment: choose a small visible health pledge and confirm it at cast release.
wizards.input_sequence: Primary prepares a normal spell for 0.30 s. Holding Cast Modifier pledges 6 health with a visible red commitment ring; release primary to cast. Pledge is paid only on commitment, cannot kill the caster, and is unavailable below 30 health.
wizards.normal_cast: Unpledged primary always casts normally. Pledging and canceling before release spends nothing; no random pain, self-stun, or voice input is required.
wizards.mastery: Confirm the pledge with Modifier A inside the final 100 ms release cue: the spell costs 15% less mana. Pay the 6 health whether the confirmation is mastered or merely normal; self-damage cannot trigger damage-taken or lifesteal effects.
wizards.signature: Scar Covenant — 22 s cooldown, 20 mana plus 10 health, 0.40 s windup; unavailable below 40 health. Gain 35 shield for 3 s and 5% movement speed for 1.5 s. Shield expiration never heals pledged health; global shield and speed caps apply.
wizards.passive: Measured Risk — while health is below 150, the first direct spell hit every 6 s restores 8 stamina. No automatic healing, extra damage, or benefit from lowering health repeatedly.
wizards.range_preference: Mid and close range; resource-for-health choices under pressure.
wizards.weakness: Every pledge permanently reduces round health unless a separately purchased healing effect repairs it.
wizards.counterplay: Make small trades to punish pledges, disengage during the covenant shield, and pressure her when low health limits commitment.
wizards.lore: A healer who now writes only contracts she is willing to pay herself.
wizards.visual_identity: Crimson binding cords, pale medical linen, and a plainly visible red pledge ring.
wizards.audio_identity: A muted heartbeat cue and a drawn needle-like note at pledge commitment.

wizards.name: Sion Palimpsest
wizards.title: The Clause Reader
wizards.casting_mode: Conditional parsing: choose the correct branch of a displayed spell sentence.
wizards.input_sequence: Cast Modifier shows a fixed two-clause rule for the selected spell, such as “if grounded choose left, otherwise choose right.” Select the true branch with A/B, then primary commits after 0.30 s. Conditions use the caster’s plainly visible state only.
wizards.normal_cast: Either branch still casts normally. State is sampled when the sentence opens and stays frozen for the preparation; it cannot change secretly between selection and commitment.
wizards.mastery: Choose the true branch within 0.35 s and commit within another 0.20 s: pay 15% less mana. The sentence library is fixed and learnable; choices never involve guessing a concealed opponent or unknown status.
wizards.signature: Correction Ribbon — 18 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Send a visible Shadow ribbon at 18 m/s up to 10 m. First enemy hit takes 22 arcane damage and has an active soft slow shortened by up to 0.5 s while gaining a new 20% slow for 1 s; stronger-slow-only rules apply, so it cannot stack.
wizards.passive: Second Draft — after making a wrong branch selection, the next correct normal cast within 3 s restores 4 mana, once per 8 s and capped at 25% of its paid cost. Errors never produce extra damage.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; decisions under changing self-state.
wizards.weakness: Branch reading has mental overhead, and choosing incorrectly grants no mastery advantage.
wizards.counterplay: Pressure while clauses are visible, vary engagement range, and evade the ribbon’s straight visible path.
wizards.lore: An editor of forbidden treaties who learned that one conditional can change a battle.
wizards.visual_identity: Layered gray paper-like collar, violet ribbons, and clear two-branch punctuation glyphs.
wizards.audio_identity: A page turn, a forked whisper, and a stamp for selected branch.

wizards.name: Kezi Facet
wizards.title: The Truthstone
wizards.casting_mode: Orientation puzzle: rotate a virtual three-face crystal to show the required face.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier; A rotates the crystal left and B tilts it upward, each with a 0.10 s step. Primary commits once a face is frontmost. Starting orientation and target are fixed per selected spell.
wizards.normal_cast: Any frontmost face casts normally after 0.35 s. Assisted mode displays one rotation at a time and yields normal output at the same preparation duration.
wizards.mastery: Reach the target face using the displayed minimum two- or three-rotation solution within 0.65 s: pay 15% less mana. Repeating rotations, randomizing the face, or holding a key grants no bonus.
wizards.signature: Facet Shatter — 18 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.40 s windup. Launch a visible 20 m/s Frost crystal up to 12 m; first solid impact bursts in a 1.5 m radius for 28 thermal damage and applies 15% slow for 1 s. Requires sight from impact point to each target and creates no persistent field.
wizards.passive: Stable Face — after 1 s without sprinting, the next spell grants 10 shield for 1 s, once per 6 s. Turning and walking remain allowed.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; planned casting from stable positions.
wizards.weakness: Orientation problem diverts attention, and shield duration is too short for prolonged turtling.
wizards.counterplay: Rush during rotations, use cover to deny crystal bursts, and change angle before her stable cast.
wizards.lore: A gemstone examiner whose crystals remember which way the world was made.
wizards.visual_identity: Pale turquoise facet plates, a three-faced hovering crystal, and hard geometric Frost flashes.
wizards.audio_identity: Distinct crystal rotation clicks and a brittle shatter cue.

wizards.name: Halvek Oath
wizards.title: The Eventbinder
wizards.casting_mode: Declared event casting: select a near-term public event and release in response.
wizards.input_sequence: Cast Modifier declares one of three events: own landing, own common melee recovery ending, or own spell cooldown becoming ready. Primary arms one spell for up to 1.5 s; press primary again to release manually or on the chosen event cue.
wizards.normal_cast: Manual release after 0.30 s always gives normal output. Arming does not spend mana; timeout cancels. No enemy action must occur and no event auto-aims or auto-fires.
wizards.mastery: Release within 100 ms after the declared event’s cue: gain 12% lower mana cost. Events must originate from genuine gameplay actions; repeated harmless button toggles cannot create an event.
wizards.signature: Oathpost — 20 s cooldown, 25 mana, 0.40 s windup. Plant a visible 45-health post within 6 m for 4 s. If the caster casts within 2 m of it, the first committed cast grants 25 shield for 1.5 s, then post expires. No bonus if it is destroyed; one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Kept Word — completing two different declared events across separate casts grants 10 stamina, once per 7 s. Manual releases do not qualify but remain normal casts.
wizards.range_preference: Close and mid range; responsive transitions after actions.
wizards.weakness: Armed spells can expire before a chosen event, and Oathpost announces a valuable position.
wizards.counterplay: Force movement away from the post, delay or deny his follow-up actions, and attack just before the expected event release.
wizards.lore: A sworn roadwarden whose magic depends on promises that can be observed.
wizards.visual_identity: Dark brown oath cords, a carved post charm, and a clearly visible armed-event emblem.
wizards.audio_identity: A vow syllable at arming and a deep wooden knock at the qualifying event.

wizards.name: Nami Drift
wizards.title: The Guided Ember
wizards.casting_mode: Cursor shepherding: guide a virtual drifting mote through two gates with controlled corrections.
wizards.input_sequence: Hold Cast Modifier to open a fixed corner widget; A/B apply left/right steering impulses to a mote while it drifts upward for 0.60 s. Primary commits at the top. Aim and movement remain live; the widget never steers world projectiles.
wizards.normal_cast: Reaching the top at any horizontal position yields normal output. Guided mode follows the center channel and takes the same 0.60 s preparation without the mastery reward.
wizards.mastery: Pass both gate centers within 8% of widget width using at most four steering impulses: pay 15% less mana. The same selected spell has the same gate layout; rapid repeated taps reduce control rather than granting power.
wizards.signature: Drift Fan — 16 s cooldown, 20 mana, 0.30 s windup. Create a neutral 3 m-wide by 5 m-long wind lane within 6 m for 3 s. Steam inside moves 2 m/s along its visible arrow; bodies inside receive a 10% movement-speed increase in the arrow direction, capped by global speed limits. No damage; one field allocation.
wizards.passive: Small Corrections — after walking at least 2 m without sprint or dodge, the next spell refunds 4 mana on a direct hit, once per 6 s, no more than 25% of paid cost. Proc damage cannot trigger it.
wizards.range_preference: Mid range; controls sightlines and steady movement.
wizards.weakness: Shepherding takes the longest fixed preparation, and wind lanes can assist an opponent equally.
wizards.counterplay: Push during the 0.60 s widget, travel with her wind when useful, and reposition after steam moves.
wizards.lore: A festival lantern-maker who turned patient corrections into a martial discipline.
wizards.visual_identity: Warm orange silk, folded paper fans, and one gently drifting ember mote.
wizards.audio_identity: Soft fan snaps, two gate chimes, and a continuous wind-lane flutter.

spells.name: Prism Ray
spells.effect: Thin hitscan ray after 0.3 s visible line windup; stops at first solid surface.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1 illuminates a 1 m impact spot for 2 s without revealing concealed players.
spells.counterplay: Break sight during windup or intercept with a ward.

spells.name: Refraction Fan
spells.effect: Three diverging telegraphed rays resolve together; two hits deal 32, three deal 40.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2 total; mirror props can redirect one ray once at -30% damage.
spells.counterplay: Use a gap or cover; watch visible reflected segment.

spells.name: Solar Ward
spells.effect: Gain 45 shield for 3 s; on break emit harmless flash identifying caster location within line of sight.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; shield never reveals attacker or forces aim distortion.
spells.counterplay: Delay attack, break shield, or flank during glow.

spells.name: Lens Gate
spells.effect: Place a visible 1.5 m-wide lens for 6 s; either player's direct projectile passing once gains +10% speed, no damage; max one amplification.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; lens has 30 health; cannot bend shots behind cover.
spells.counterplay: Use lens yourself or destroy it.

spells.name: Mirror Walk
spells.effect: Teleport up to 5 m to visible walkable position; leave a 15-health decoy for 2 s; decoy never casts.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1 at both positions combined; decoy consumes summon slot.
spells.counterplay: Track endpoint flash or test decoy with one shot.

spells.name: Sunmark
spells.effect: 32 m/s dart reveals a hit target 1.5 s; miss illuminates ground only; no homing followup.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1; opaque effects still hide normal models despite revealed silhouette duration.
spells.counterplay: Dodge dart or wait out brief mark behind cover.

spells.name: Helios Lance
spells.effect: A 0.4 m-wide ray after long line telegraph; caster movement -20% while winding up; 0.35 s recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Light 3; mirrors cannot reflect this heavy ray; surviving geometry stops it.
spells.counterplay: Break sight or punish exposed caster.

spells.name: Radiant Reversal
spells.effect: A 0.25 s forward disc catches first ray/projectile up to 40 damage; recast within 1 s releases one 30 m/s bolt; missed catch gives no bolt.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2 maximum; bolt is secondary, cannot create further defensive procs.
spells.counterplay: Bait window or attack from another direction.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.effect: 24 m/s projectile; 1.8 m splash; direct and splash cannot both damage one target.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 2 at impact consumes water and makes a bounded steam patch.
spells.counterplay: Dodge the visible projectile or intercept with a ward.

spells.name: Cinder Sweep
spells.effect: 90-degree cone; check cover per target; caster slows 15% during windup.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1 along the cone dries thin wetness.
spells.counterplay: Back out of reach or flank the cone.

spells.name: Heat Haze
spells.effect: A visible personal shimmer lasts 4 s; reduces incoming projectile damage 12%; does not alter aim or hitboxes.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1 dries caster wetness once; shimmer remains visually identifiable.
spells.counterplay: Use melee, wait out duration, or overwhelm limited reduction.

spells.name: Ash Curtain
spells.effect: Create a 3 m-radius opaque ash cloud for 6 s; no damage or reveal inside.
spells.world_interaction: Wind displaces it; water collapses it; ash does not absorb projectiles.
spells.counterplay: Listen, shoot through, or disperse the cloud.

spells.name: Phoenix Rush
spells.effect: Dash up to 8 m along ground; stops at solid geometry; 1 m endpoint burst; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: A 1 m-wide Heat 1 trail persists 3 s and deals 6/s to any entrant.
spells.counterplay: Track the telegraphed path or block the endpoint.

spells.name: Boiler Orb
spells.effect: 18 m/s orb waits on first surface for up to 3 s; recast detonates within 2 m.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 3; water reaction consumes orb heat and creates steam, reducing explosion to 16.
spells.counterplay: Shoot the 25-health orb or exploit premature steaming.

spells.name: Flame Lash
spells.effect: A visible curved whip strikes along a 0.5 m-wide arc; hit adds Burn 4/s for 3 s.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1 ignites dry growth touched by the arc.
spells.counterplay: Parry the lash or retreat before its fixed arc resolves.

spells.name: Flashforge
spells.effect: Smash a 2 m-radius ground area; intact metal prop within it becomes red-hot for 4 s, dealing 8/s on contact.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 3; metal is still destructible and walkable rules remain unchanged.
spells.counterplay: Leave the raised casting marker; cool or avoid the hot prop.

spells.name: Inkspike
spells.effect: 30 m/s ink shard; after impact leaves a 15-health written dot for 3 s; dot has no damage by itself.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1; Water washes dot, Heat makes nonblocking glass.
spells.counterplay: Dodge shard or erase written dot.

spells.name: Paragraph Wall
spells.effect: Create a 3 m-wide, 2 m-high 65-health parchment wall for 6 s; letter gaps form one 1 m doorway.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 2; Water removes 15 health once, Heat burns at normal thermal damage.
spells.counterplay: Use doorway, flank, or break parchment.

spells.name: Erasure Guard
spells.effect: Gain 45 shield for 3 s; casting any damaging spell removes 10 remaining shield; utility casts do not.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1; visual letters disappear with lost shield.
spells.counterplay: Force caster to spend shield offensively or wait it out.

spells.name: Margin Slide
spells.effect: Dash 6 m along a fixed straight line; passing within 1 m of own written dot consumes dot and creates 1 m dust puff for 1 s.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1; no invisibility or resource refund.
spells.counterplay: Deny prepared dot or guard endpoint.

spells.name: Dust Script
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius opaque dust circle lasts 5 s; its rim remains bright and sound passes normally.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 2; Wind disperses, Water settles dust into nonblocking mud.
spells.counterplay: Listen, shoot through, or clear dust.

spells.name: Living Footnote
spells.effect: One 40-health paper familiar lasts 6 s; follows a fixed 6 m route and fires 18 m/s shards only within 4 m visible reach.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1; Heat destroys familiar at normal damage; no hidden enemy detection.
spells.counterplay: Break familiar or avoid route.

spells.name: Comma Trap
spells.effect: A visible 25-health comma lasts 6 s; first entrant within 0.8 m starts 0.4 s warning, then root 0.5 s; global immunity applies.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 2; Water consumes written trigger; root never extends with repeated ticks.
spells.counterplay: Destroy comma or leave warning.

spells.name: Final Revision
spells.effect: Write one 2 m-radius marker; within 0.8 s may move it once <=3 m; marker then erupts after another 0.5 s.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 3; relocation visible; cover blocks damage.
spells.counterplay: Track final marker and exit during fixed warning.

spells.name: Sonic Pulse
spells.effect: A 90-degree pressure cone; hit pushes 1 m; solid cover blocks pulse.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1 vibrates fragile props at normal physical damage.
spells.counterplay: Back out of range or flank cone.

spells.name: Chime Needle
spells.effect: 36 m/s needle leaves a 2 s impact chime audible within 10 m; hit grants no automatic reveal.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; chime is neutral positional information.
spells.counterplay: Dodge needle or reposition away from impact.

spells.name: Beat Guard
spells.effect: For 3 s three clear beats occur 1 s apart; each opens a 0.15 s window of 20% damage reduction; outside windows none.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; reduction obeys total cap; buff does not automatically parry.
spells.counterplay: Attack between beats or delay burst.

spells.name: Echo Ping
spells.effect: Send a visible ground-following wave; a directly contacted enemy is revealed 1 s; caster broadcasts position audibly within 24 m.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1 can pass only one open doorway, never solid walls.
spells.counterplay: Avoid wave, change elevation, or use caster's audible location.

spells.name: Hush Pocket
spells.effect: A visible 2.5 m-radius field lasts 5 s; attenuates footsteps by 40% inside, but attack/cast/impact cues retain full volume.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; both players gain quiet footsteps; field edge hum remains audible.
spells.counterplay: Watch field edge or use vision and normal attack tells.

spells.name: Marching Note
spells.effect: A 10 m-by-2 m lane lasts 5 s; everyone following its direction receives +15% speed; entering/exiting emits positional chime.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; no stamina refund or extra dash charges.
spells.counterplay: Use lane yourself or aim at audible exits.

spells.name: Dissonance Cut
spells.effect: Forward 0.8 m slash interrupts an active channel for 0.4 s; does not silence unrelated future casts.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; interruption shares hard-control immunity.
spells.counterplay: Parry or stop channel before slash arrives.

spells.name: Counterchorus
spells.effect: A 0.5 m-wide ray after audible line windup silences hit target 0.6 s; hard-control immunity applies.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; only direct sight can be struck.
spells.counterplay: Leave telegraphed line or attack during windup.

spells.name: Formula Bolt
spells.effect: 34 m/s bolt; select narrow 0.3 m or wide 0.6 m before cast; wide costs 16 mana and deals 28.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 1 on impact; variants are fixed formulas, never new spells.
spells.counterplay: Dodge chosen width or use cover.

spells.name: Operator Fork
spells.effect: Choose parallel or diverging two-bolt geometry before release; 28 m/s; both patterns visibly telegraphed.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 1 total; projectiles stop at solid geometry.
spells.counterplay: Use announced gap or block one arm.

spells.name: Proof Shield
spells.effect: Gain 50 shield for 3 s; next offensive cast during shield costs 4 extra mana; defensive/utility spells do not.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 1; no mana restored on shield expiration.
spells.counterplay: Force offensive response or wait out proof.

spells.name: Vector Bracket
spells.effect: Choose straight 6 m dash or 4 m teleport before release; route/arrival must be visible and legal; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 1 marks chosen branch and endpoint.
spells.counterplay: Read branch before launch and guard endpoint.

spells.name: Variable Cell
spells.effect: A 2 m-radius, 35-health field lasts 5 s; any projectile first crossing gains +10% speed OR -10% speed, chosen at placement.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 2; affects both players; cannot modify same projectile twice.
spells.counterplay: Use announced modifier yourself or destroy cell.

spells.name: Closure Trap
spells.effect: A visible 25-health triangular rune lasts 6 s; first entrant crossing two edges within 1 s triggers 1.5 m burst after 0.4 s warning.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 2; one cast never triggers twice.
spells.counterplay: Cross one edge only, jump over, or destroy rune.

spells.name: Null Quotient
spells.effect: A narrow telegraphed ray damages first visible target; deployable bonus cannot bypass player shields or surviving cover.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 2; no spell theft, resource drain, or passive suppression.
spells.counterplay: Hide valuable anchor or break ray sight.

spells.name: Expression Storm
spells.effect: Three 28 m/s bolts launch in selected line/triangle pattern over 0.5 s; direction locked at release; no auto-aim.
spells.world_interaction: Arcane 3 total; all bolts share source and event budget.
spells.counterplay: Dodge pattern gaps or interrupt windup.

spells.name: Iron Shard
spells.effect: 40 m/s narrow shard; lodged visual marker lasts 2 s but grants no reveal through walls.
