spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 at impact; can temporarily connect two touching conductive surfaces only.
spells.counterplay: Dodge or intercept narrow trajectory.

spells.name: Blade Halo
spells.effect: One 270-degree visible sweep; rear 90-degree gap remains; 0.25 s recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 sparks on impact; does not cut permanent map structure.
spells.counterplay: Stay in rear gap or parry edge timing.

spells.name: Mercury Mirror
spells.effect: For 0.3 s a forward 100-degree disc reflects first non-hitscan projectile with original damage x 0.70, max 45; 0.4 s miss recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1; reflected projectile is secondary damage and cannot spawn another reflection.
spells.counterplay: Bait timing or use beams/melee/flank attacks.

spells.name: Ferric Screen
spells.effect: Place a 2.5 m-wide, 2 m-high, 70-health lattice for 5 s; blocks projectiles but has 1 m doorway; rays stop on bars only.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 2 conducts electricity only through intact bars.
spells.counterplay: Use doorway, aim through gaps, or destroy bars.

spells.name: Quicksilver Lunge
spells.effect: Dash up to 6 m; stab only within 2 m of endpoint; endpoint fixed before travel; 0.3 s recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 at endpoint; no invulnerability or automatic tracking.
spells.counterplay: Dodge endpoint or body-block path behind cover.

spells.name: Serration Mark
spells.effect: 30 m/s bolt; Bleed duration refreshes but intensity never stacks; cleansing consumes mark.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 at impact; bleeding is physical, not corrosive.
spells.counterplay: Evade bolt or cleanse the named Bleed.

spells.name: Needle Line
spells.effect: Three 45 m/s needles fire over 0.3 s; casting fixes initial direction; target receives at most three hits.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 total; multi-hit does not multiply source strength.
spells.counterplay: Strafe across fixed stream or use cover.

spells.name: Railbreaker
spells.effect: 55 m/s lance; caster -20% speed during windup and 0.4 s recovery; stops at first solid surface.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 3 damages cover normally; never penetrates surviving cover.
spells.counterplay: Read long telegraph, flank, or intercept shot.

spells.name: Reverb Shot
spells.effect: 30 m/s pressure orb may bounce once on solid surface; visible predicted bounce line; hit destroys orb.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; cannot acquire target through walls after bounce.
spells.counterplay: Read reflected line or intercept orb.

spells.name: Resonant Bell
spells.effect: Place a 35-health bell for 6 s; three 2 m-radius pulses at 1 s intervals damage all nearby entrants.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; can shake loose only designated destructible props.
spells.counterplay: Shoot bell or step out between audible beats.

spells.name: Last Word
spells.effect: For 2 s, taking at least 20 direct damage readies one 32 m/s reply projectile; recast within 1 s of readiness fires; no damage reduction.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 3 on release; secondary shot cannot chain retaliations.
spells.counterplay: Withhold damage during brief window or dodge reply.

spells.name: Marching Rest
spells.effect: Gain 40 shield for 4 s; remaining still for 0.5 s grants another 10 once, still <=50 absorbed per cast; attacks do not extend it.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; shield beat audible; no healing or repeated gain.
spells.counterplay: Force movement or break shield before rest.

spells.name: Echo Mine
spells.effect: Place a 25-health rune for 6 s; first entrant within 1 m triggers a 0.4 s warning then 1.5 m burst.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; hum becomes louder near rune; no hard control.
spells.counterplay: Shoot rune or escape during warning delay.

spells.name: Beat Skip
spells.effect: Dash 6 m after one fixed audible 0.3 s count-in; target direction may be chosen during count-in; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1 at start/end; tells retained at all accessibility volume settings.
spells.counterplay: Attack during count-in or track arrival cue.

spells.name: Resonance Tether
spells.effect: 26 m/s tuning bolt links hit to 25-health impact anchor; extra damage requires uninterrupted direct line and target within 6 m.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; tether never detects movement through fog or walls.
spells.counterplay: Break sight, leave radius, or destroy anchor.

spells.name: Grand Crescendo
spells.effect: Channel up to 2 s in 60-degree cone; costs 8 mana/s after initial spend; release after full channel adds final pulse; movement -20%.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 3 total; repeated ticks cannot escalate source strength.
spells.counterplay: Interrupt, flank, or leave cone before final note.

spells.name: Chain Spark
spells.effect: 32 m/s spark; at most three jumps, each <=6 m, to connected Wet surfaces, metal props, or visible targets; each target damaged once.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 1; conductivity requires an actual connected route; jumps never reveal concealed targets.
spells.counterplay: Break connected wet route or avoid nearby conductors.

spells.name: Static Jab
spells.effect: Short forward stab; against a Wet target damage is 36 instead; no automatic stun.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 1 at contact; direct spell still requires contact.
spells.counterplay: Parry or leave melee reach.

spells.name: Crosswind
spells.effect: A 4 m-by-2 m field lasts 4 s; shifts all non-hitscan projectile velocity sideways by 15 degrees once on entry.
spells.world_interaction: Wind 2 moves vapor 3 m; does not reflect ownership or increase projectile damage.
spells.counterplay: Use beams, anticipate deflection, or fire around field.

spells.name: Charge Pylon
spells.effect: Place a 40-health 1.5 m-radius pylon field for 6 s; it damages every entrant, including caster, at 0.5 s ticks.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 2, never chains beyond connected puddle touching pylon; one damage tick per target.
spells.counterplay: Shoot pylon from outside radius or isolate its liquid route.

spells.name: Skyhook Surge
spells.effect: Attach to visible solid anchor <=10 m away; reel caster up to 8 m over 0.5 s; tether can be cut at 20 damage.
spells.world_interaction: Wind 2 clears a 1 m-wide corridor of vapor; never crosses solid surfaces.
spells.counterplay: Cut glowing tether or cover predictable arrival.

spells.name: Magnetic Draft
spells.effect: 24 m/s bolt pulls target 2.5 m only when they stand within 1.5 m of a conductive metal prop; otherwise 20% slow for 1 s.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 2 consumes charge on selected prop; no equipment-based unavoidable targeting.
spells.counterplay: Leave metal prop vicinity or break line of sight.

spells.name: Lightning Rail
spells.effect: A 0.35 m-wide ray resolves after a bright 0.6 s line telegraph; cannot penetrate solid cover.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 2 energizes connected wet tiles along line for 1 s, dealing 6/s once per target.
spells.counterplay: Leave the telegraphed line or shelter behind cover.

spells.name: Forked Verdict
spells.effect: Aim two parallel telegraphed rays 1.5 m apart; resolve after 0.7 s; a target hit by both takes 54 total.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 3 maximum; cannot chain beyond same-cast hit footprint.
spells.counterplay: Stand in the visible gap or move outside both rays.

spells.name: Pebble Shot
spells.effect: 30 m/s stone; a shot that first bounces off one solid surface loses 25% damage; max one bounce.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1 at final impact; no growing debris pile.
spells.counterplay: Track single bank angle or stop shot with cover.

spells.name: Granite Knuckle
spells.effect: Wide 1 m thrust; hit pushes 2 m; caster has 0.35 s recovery and -20% speed during windup.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2 damages cover normally; cannot punch through intact walls.
spells.counterplay: Parry, retreat, or punish recovery.

spells.name: Stonewall
spells.effect: Raise a 3 m-wide, 2 m-high, 100-health wall for 6 s; gaps smaller than 1 m cannot be sealed.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; blocks sight/projectiles; destruction leaves nonblocking rubble.
spells.counterplay: Flank, jump around, or damage its limited health.

spells.name: Rampmaker
spells.effect: Create a 5 m-long, 2 m-wide, 70-health ramp for 7 s; rise max 2 m; must attach to reachable ground.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; all players can use it; does not cross lethal voids or boundary.
spells.counterplay: Break ramp, contest its crest, or take another route.

spells.name: Burrow Feint
spells.effect: Move up to 5 m along visible ground over 0.5 s with a clear moving mound; caster remains damageable; no passing walls.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1 leaves one 2 m dust puff for 2 s at departure.
spells.counterplay: Track mound or block route with geometry.

spells.name: Clay Grip
spells.effect: Ground marker rises after 0.5 s, applying 25% slow for 1.5 s to targets in 1.5 m radius.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1 plus Water 1 creates mud; drying removes slow source.
spells.counterplay: Leave marker or jump before emergence.

spells.name: Faultline
spells.effect: A visible 12 m-by-1.5 m crack erupts after 0.75 s; hit lifts target 0.5 m, interrupting for 0.4 s.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; no persistent canyon; hard-control rules apply.
spells.counterplay: Step off crack or use an airborne route.

spells.name: Monolith Divide
spells.effect: Raise two 2 m-wide, 2.5 m-high, 90-health pillars 3 m apart for 7 s; visible placement cannot overlap players or seal routes.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 3 shared across pillars; world field slot counts as one cast.
spells.counterplay: Use central gap or destroy one pillar.

spells.name: Pressure Jet
spells.effect: 35 m/s stream projectile pushes hit target 1.5 m; collision push damage is never added.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1 wets the first impact surface.
spells.counterplay: Sidestep its narrow line or anchor behind cover.

spells.name: Water Hammer
spells.effect: A 0.8 m-wide thrust; hit pushes 2 m; a miss leaves 0.3 s recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1 sprays only the impact spot.
spells.counterplay: Parry, sidestep, or punish recovery.

spells.name: Bubble Buckler
spells.effect: Gain a forward 45-point shield for 4 s; protects a 100-degree arc; common shield cap applies.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1 when broken; Heat consumes 10 shield to create a 1 m steam puff.
spells.counterplay: Flank, use melee from another angle, or break limited shield.

spells.name: Water Pool
spells.effect: Place a connected 3 m-radius shallow pool for 6 s; entrants are Wet; no automatic slow.
spells.world_interaction: Water 2; Heat creates steam; Frost freezes it; electricity stays within its connected footprint.
spells.counterplay: Leave the marked pool or consume it with heat/frost.

spells.name: Cascade Vault
spells.effect: Launch self toward a visible landing point up to 6 m away and 3 m higher; no flight or invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1 at launch and landing, combined source cap Water 2.
spells.counterplay: Track airborne arc and attack the fixed landing.

spells.name: Riptide Lane
spells.effect: Create a 10 m-long, 2 m-wide shallow stream for 6 s; everyone moving with its arrow gets +15% speed.
spells.world_interaction: Water 2 along lane; crosswise travel has no speed bonus; remains connected for electricity.
spells.counterplay: Use the lane yourself or freeze/disrupt its route.

spells.name: Deepglass Prison
spells.effect: 22 m/s bubble projectile roots a hit target for 0.6 s; then applies 20% slow for 1.5 s.
spells.world_interaction: Water 2 at impact; root obeys global immunity; cannot float or imprison indefinitely.
spells.counterplay: Dodge the bubble or trigger its control while protected by hard-control immunity.

spells.name: Seal the Spring
spells.effect: A 2 m-radius splash removes up to 2 reaction units from one visible hot/corrosive ground field; requires a surface impact.
spells.world_interaction: Water 2 is fully consumed in neutralization; no surviving pool.
spells.counterplay: Move fight away from countered field or defend the cast.

spells.name: Weight Bolt
spells.effect: 30 m/s bolt adds 15% slow for 1.25 s; jump height unchanged.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1 on impact; no equipment weight checks.
spells.counterplay: Dodge narrow projectile or wait out slow behind cover.

spells.name: Heavy Palm
spells.effect: Forward 1 m-wide palm pushes target 1.5 m; fixed direction selected at windup.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1 at contact; no additional wall collision damage.
spells.counterplay: Parry or sidestep close strike.

spells.name: Mass Anchor
spells.effect: For 4 s halve hostile displacement distance and gain 10% reduction against airborne-projectile damage; movement -10%.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; does not prevent stun/root/silence.
spells.counterplay: Use melee/rays or disengage from slow target.

spells.name: Gravity Well
spells.effect: A 2.5 m-radius field lasts 4 s; entrants moving away from center have 20% slow; no automatic forced pull.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1 bends loose decorative debris only; cannot drag players through terrain.
spells.counterplay: Move through center or destroy 30-health anchor.

spells.name: Lightfoot Orbit
spells.effect: For 4 s gain +10% speed and reduce jump stamina cost by 20%; fall arc and landing remain normal.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1 produces visible ankle orbit; no flight or infinite jumps.
spells.counterplay: Track normal landing or wait out buff.

spells.name: Pendulum Mark
spells.effect: 24 m/s bolt marks target for 2 s; recast within direct sight pulls target 1.5 m toward original impact anchor; max once.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1; mark cannot pull through walls and respects control immunity.
spells.counterplay: Break sight or bait recast near safe cover.

spells.name: Orbital Sling
spells.effect: 24 m/s stone follows one visible 30-degree left/right curve chosen during cast; no homing.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1 guides Earth 1 stone; both consumed at impact.
spells.counterplay: Read chosen curve or shelter behind solid geometry.

spells.name: Weighted Thread
spells.effect: 28 m/s tether bolt creates 30-health ground knot for 4 s; target beyond 4 m from knot is slowed 25%, only while line remains clear.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; no hard root, global slow cap remains.
spells.counterplay: Destroy knot or break line of sight.

spells.name: Kinetic Bolt
spells.effect: 34 m/s projectile; target impact does not stagger or interrupt automatically.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1 affects breakable props at normal damage.
spells.counterplay: Dodge or intercept visible bolt.

spells.name: Force Palm
spells.effect: A 60-degree cone pushes targets 1.5 m; cover blocks; displacement takes 0.25 s and obeys hard-control lockout.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1 can move only designated loose props up to 1 m.
spells.counterplay: Back out, parry, or flank cone.

spells.name: Vector Shield
spells.effect: For 4 s gain a 50-point forward 110-degree shield; turning shield follows aim with 0.15 s lag.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2; melee from protected arc damages shield normally.
spells.counterplay: Flank or exploit turning lag.

spells.name: Catchfield
spells.effect: Place a 2 m-wide, 1.8 m-high field for 4 s; absorbs at most 45 total projectile damage from either direction, then vanishes.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2; rays/melee unaffected; absorption respects protected target shield cap.
spells.counterplay: Use rays, exhaust field, or step around it.

spells.name: Repulse Hop
spells.effect: Dash backward up to 4 m relative to current facing; stops at geometry; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1 creates audible launch pulse; no damaging shockwave.
spells.counterplay: Follow endpoint or deny clear escape lane.

spells.name: Pressure Cage
spells.effect: A marked 2.5 m-radius ring forms after 0.6 s for 4 s; crossing ring slows 25% for 1 s; never blocks movement.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2; 45-health anchor; no damage beyond emergence.
spells.counterplay: Leave warning, jump ring, or destroy anchor.

spells.name: Compression Orb
spells.effect: 16 m/s, 30-health orb; 2 m explosion; direct and splash exclusive; loses 10 damage if shot before impact.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2; explosion pushes 1 m once and respects control immunity.
spells.counterplay: Destroy early, dodge orb, or shelter from blast.

spells.name: Counterweight
spells.effect: Pay 15 stamina; for 3 s gain 15% damage reduction but movement -15%; manually ending gives no refund.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1 braces caster; reduction cap applies.
spells.counterplay: Kite, flank, or force stamina-intensive escape.

spells.name: Seed Shot
spells.effect: 30 m/s seed embeds in surface as a 15-health bud for 3 s; recast pops it for 12 in 1 m radius.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1 shared by seed/bud; Wet surface extends bud to 4 s, never beyond cap.
spells.counterplay: Dodge seed or destroy bud before recast.

spells.name: Briar Fist
spells.effect: Strike adds Bleed 3/s for 2 s; Bleed uses same named nonstacking effect as other sources.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1 at impact; fire can remove surface thorns without cleansing a hit.
spells.counterplay: Parry or maintain spacing.

spells.name: Graft Guard
spells.effect: For 4 s absorb next 30 direct damage into a visible 35-health bud on caster; surviving bud heals 15 when duration ends; damage reduction cap applies.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1; attacks can break bud separately and cancel heal.
spells.counterplay: Attack exposed bud or wait before committing burst.

spells.name: Thorn Snare
spells.effect: Plant a 25-health, 0.8 m-radius thorn knot for 6 s; first entrant is rooted 0.5 s; knot then dies.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1; dry growth burns; water adds 10 knot health once.
spells.counterplay: Shoot obvious knot, jump over, or trigger during control immunity.

spells.name: Vine Swing
spells.effect: Latch visible solid anchor <=10 m; swing self up to 7 m over 0.6 s; movement remains exposed; 20-health tether.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1; heat cuts tether; no repeated airborne swings from one cast.
spells.counterplay: Shoot tether or predict landing arc.

spells.name: Hedge Mazelet
spells.effect: Two 3 m-long, 1.8 m-high, 55-health hedges with 1.5 m gap last 7 s; block sight but projectiles penetrate at -25% damage.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 2 shared; water adds 10 health per hedge once; heat burns.
spells.counterplay: Fire through, destroy hedges, or contest central gap.

spells.name: Spore Lantern
spells.effect: Place a 30-health lantern for 6 s; each visible enemy entering its 3 m radius is revealed for 1 s, once per cast.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1; mist still blocks lantern sight; no through-wall detection.
spells.counterplay: Destroy lantern or approach behind opaque terrain.

spells.name: Sap Bind
spells.effect: 22 m/s blob; hit adds 30% slow for 1.25 s; misses leave one 1.5 m sticky patch for 3 s with 20% slow.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 2; water washes patch away; heat hardens it into nonsticky residue.
spells.counterplay: Evade slow blob or wash its residue.

spells.name: Gust Plate
spells.effect: A 3 m-wide wind front moves 18 m/s and pushes hit targets 1 m once.
spells.world_interaction: Wind 1 displaces smoke/steam 2 m along its direction.
spells.counterplay: Use terrain to stop push or move across its narrow front.

spells.name: Thunder Knell
spells.effect: A visible 180-degree pulse; hit disrupts active channel for 0.4 s under global control rules.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 1 at pulse edge; does not pass solid walls.
spells.counterplay: Back away or dodge behind caster during windup.

spells.name: Thunderclap Parry
spells.effect: Open a 0.25 s forward parry; first melee/projectile within arc is stopped up to 50 damage and fires a 3 m cone; 0.4 s miss recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 1 only on successful cone; shield/reduction caps still apply.
spells.counterplay: Bait the timing, use a heavy shot, or strike outside arc.

spells.name: Tempest Crown
spells.effect: Place a 4 m-radius storm field for 6 s; visible central eye of radius 1 m is safe; strongest 20% slow on outer ring.
spells.world_interaction: Wind 2 and Electrical 2 share one field; vapor gathers in eye; no automatic target tracking.
spells.counterplay: Use safe eye, destroy its 60-health anchor, or leave radius.

spells.name: Stormline Dash
spells.effect: Dash up to 8 m; leaves visible lightning line for 0.6 s; first target contacted takes damage once; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 1 on traversed connected Wet footprint, no new water connection.
spells.counterplay: Sidestep path or hold angle at endpoint.

spells.name: Storm Kite
spells.effect: For 3 s gain 15% air steering and halve fall damage; no lift, hover, or extra jumps.
spells.world_interaction: Wind 1 scatters nearby mist within 1 m once.
spells.counterplay: Track predictable landing; buff does not protect direct attacks.

spells.name: Ball Lightning
spells.effect: 10 m/s 30-health orb flies straight for up to 2.4 s; 2 m burst on impact/destruction.
spells.world_interaction: Electrical 2; water extends burst through connected patch, never radius beyond 3 m from impact.
spells.counterplay: Destroy it at safe distance or move behind solid cover.

spells.name: Slipstream Trace
spells.effect: Draw one 8 m-by-2 m wind lane for 5 s; all players moving perpendicular get +10% speed for 1 s, once per cast.
spells.world_interaction: Wind 2 shifts vapor 2 m perpendicular to lane; cannot extend lifetime.
spells.counterplay: Use lane yourself or disrupt planned crossing.

spells.name: Impulse Kick
spells.effect: A downward 1 m-wide kick; while caster is airborne add 10% damage, combined mastery/position bonus max 25%; 0.25 s recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1; no additional jump generated.
spells.counterplay: Watch jump timing or parry landing strike.

spells.name: Rift Ram
spells.effect: Dash up to 8 m on fixed line; first contact ends dash, dealing damage and pushing target 2 m; no invulnerability; 0.4 s recovery.
spells.world_interaction: Force 3; collisions damage cover normally but cannot pass surviving cover.
spells.counterplay: Sidestep fixed path or block with durable terrain.

spells.name: Kinetic Reserve
spells.effect: Gain 40 shield for 4 s; if it expires with >=20 shield remaining, restore 12 stamina; otherwise none.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1; restoration once, is not mana refund, and cannot trigger other refunds.
spells.counterplay: Break shield or force movement before expiry.

spells.name: Rebound Sanctuary
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius field lasts 6 s; all players inside get 12% direct-damage reduction and 50% shorter push/pull distance; speed -10%.
spells.world_interaction: Force 3; 65-health anchor; no stun/silence immunity; total reduction cap applies.
spells.counterplay: Destroy anchor, attack outside zone, or use zone yourself.

spells.name: Momentum Cut
spells.effect: Dash up to 5 m then sweep 90 degrees within 2.5 m; first target hit only; 0.3 s recovery; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1 at endpoint; no damage scaling from velocity.
spells.counterplay: Sidestep endpoint or parry sweep.

spells.name: Hammer Wave
spells.effect: A 2 m-wide wave moves 18 m/s along ground and pushes 2 m once; airborne targets above 1 m avoid it.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2 moves loose props no more than 2 m, stopping at walls.
spells.counterplay: Jump or sidestep wave.

spells.name: Vector Swap
spells.effect: Select one visible loose prop <=1 m wide and <=40 mass units; slide it up to 4 m along ground; impact causes no player damage or trapping.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2; blocked routes cancel movement; prop remains neutral cover.
spells.counterplay: Contest destination, break prop, or interrupt setup.

spells.name: Vector Barrage
spells.effect: Channel four 32 m/s shots at 0.5 s intervals; each costs 7 additional mana; aim freely, movement -20%; stop any time.
spells.world_interaction: Force 3 total; shots follow normal independent collision and trigger budget.
spells.counterplay: Break sight, flank during channel, or dodge individual bolts.

spells.name: Glimmer Blade
spells.effect: A 0.6 m-wide forward slash; weak-point head intersection adds 10% damage, max mastery combined 15%.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1 at blade edge; no blinding screen effect.
spells.counterplay: Parry or evade narrow forward line.

spells.name: Spectrum Split
spells.effect: Fire a 32 m/s orb; recast splits into two 24-damage darts diverging 15 degrees; each target max 42 from entire cast.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; split location visible and cannot occur behind solid obstruction.
spells.counterplay: Force early split or move between divergent darts.

spells.name: Prismatic Shelter
spells.effect: Place a 2 m-radius, 65-health dome for 5 s; blocks rays/projectiles in both directions; players can walk through.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; sound/ground effects pass; dome counts toward shield cap for protected target absorption.
spells.counterplay: Enter dome or break its finite shared shell.

spells.name: Beacon Pebble
spells.effect: Place a 20-health beacon for 5 s; its 2.5 m radius visibly lights terrain; enemy entering unobscured radius revealed 1 s once.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1; smoke blocks detection; beacon does not identify players behind terrain.
spells.counterplay: Break beacon or cross under cover/mist.

spells.name: Triune Dash
spells.effect: Choose advance 6 m dash, lateral 5 m dash, or retreat 4 m teleport before commitment; destination visible and legal.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1 shows chosen three-color branch; no shield or invisibility.
spells.counterplay: Read branch cue and attack endpoint.

spells.name: Daybreak Sweep
spells.effect: A 90-degree cone checks surface sight; disperses one Shadow 1 or obscurant unit per affected cell.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; removes concealment geometry only if that effect permits light dispersal; steam needs wind/heat rules.
spells.counterplay: Leave cone or use solid cover, which remains intact.

spells.name: Lightwell
spells.effect: A visible 2.5 m-radius field heals any player inside 6/s for 5 s, maximum 24 per player per cast; entering requires 0.5 s before first tick.
spells.world_interaction: Light 3; 55-health anchor can be destroyed; all healing observes global ceiling.
spells.counterplay: Claim field yourself, destroy anchor, or pressure its exposed occupants.

spells.name: False Horizon
spells.effect: Create a 4 m-wide, 2.5 m-high luminous screen for 6 s, displaying a clearly stylized empty-scene illusion; blocks sight, never collision/damage.
spells.world_interaction: Light 3; 45-health frame; sound and projectiles pass; close silhouette visible within 4 m.
spells.counterplay: Shoot through, approach, or destroy frame.

spells.name: Remembered Arrow
spells.effect: 30 m/s arrow; recast within 0.6 s rotates trajectory once toward a manually chosen new line, max 20 degrees.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; no auto-target or extra damage.
spells.counterplay: Read correction or use solid cover.

spells.name: Mnemonic Wisp
spells.effect: One 40-health wisp for 6 s repeats caster's last completed 3 m movement path; fires 18 m/s bolts within 4 m visible reach.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; cannot replay spells or see concealed targets.
spells.counterplay: Read repeated route and destroy wisp.

spells.name: Memory Guard
spells.effect: Gain 45 shield for 3 s in facing direction recorded 0.5 s before commitment; 100-degree arc, fixed after casting.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; recorded direction preview remains visible to caster.
spells.counterplay: Flank recorded angle or change attack lane.

spells.name: Return Motif
spells.effect: Dash toward own position recorded 1 s earlier, maximum 6 m; requires clear ground route; no crossing walls or invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; prior point and route visibly ghosted during windup.
spells.counterplay: Guard recorded position or block return line.

spells.name: Afterimage Record
spells.effect: Place 30-health 2 m-radius memory field for 5 s; first visible enemy crossing leaves a stationary harmless outline of crossing position for 2 s.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; outline does not follow player or provide wall tracking.
spells.counterplay: Cross deliberately to mislead or destroy anchor.

spells.name: Forgotten Door
spells.effect: Create a 3 m-wide opaque curtain for 5 s; every crossing flashes an outline at crossing point for 0.5 s, then disappears.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; no collision; sound/damage pass; outlines stay at location.
spells.counterplay: Shoot through, listen, or use crossing flash.

spells.name: Recall Trap
spells.effect: Place a 25-health rune for 6 s; record first visible entrant's direction; after 0.5 s fire one 22 m/s bolt along that recorded direction.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; bolt never homes or follows unseen target.
spells.counterplay: Change direction after recorded cue or destroy rune.

spells.name: Ancestral Chorus
spells.effect: Fire three 28 m/s bolts at own last three cast directions, recorded and previewed; if history short, repeat current direction; no other spell copied.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 3 total; projectiles stop at cover; spell history gives geometry only.
spells.counterplay: Read ghosted directions or shelter behind cover.

spells.name: Graviton Punch
spells.effect: A 1 m-wide strike; hit pushes 2.5 m over 0.3 s; miss recovery 0.35 s.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; no wall crush bonus; forced movement obeys immunity.
spells.counterplay: Parry, leave reach, or punish recovery.

spells.name: Falling Star
spells.effect: Leap toward visible ground point <=6 m and <=2 m higher; land after 0.8 s with 2 m burst; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2 lands loose debris without changing map structure.
spells.counterplay: Exit landing marker or attack exposed caster.

spells.name: Delayed Brace
spells.effect: Choose 0.3 s or 0.8 s delay before 50 shield appears for 3 s; delay selected before payment; cannot postpone again.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1; shield countdown audibly and visibly public.
spells.counterplay: Attack before shield arrives or wait it out.

spells.name: Lift Tile
spells.effect: A visible 2 m-radius tile lasts 5 s; first grounded entry launches any player 2 m upward once, preserving aim; 1 s per-player retrigger delay.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; occupants can step around tile; fall damage normal.
spells.counterplay: Avoid tile or attack predictable airborne arc.

spells.name: Zero-G Window
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius field lasts 5 s; all non-hitscan projectiles lose 15% speed and drop within it; resume original gravity on exit.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; players retain normal movement and ground traction.
spells.counterplay: Use rays/melee or aim with altered projectile arc.

spells.name: Mass Reversal
spells.effect: For 0.4 s halve first incoming push/pull and launch a dodgeable 24 m/s wave back along its origin direction, 6 m range.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 3; no reflection of stun/silence, no control immunity or automatic hit.
spells.counterplay: Bait counter, delay displacement, or sidestep reply wave.

spells.name: Singularity Lens
spells.effect: A 2 m-radius, 75-health anchor lasts 6 s; first 3 non-hitscan projectiles entering each lose up to 25 damage, then anchor expires.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 3; affects either player's shots; rays and melee unaffected.
spells.counterplay: Exhaust three catches cheaply, destroy anchor, or use rays.

spells.name: Event Horizon Ring
spells.effect: A 3.5 m-radius, 0.75 m-thick ring lasts 6 s; ring contact slows 30%; central area remains safe.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 3; damage/slow applies to all entrants; 60-health center anchor.
spells.counterplay: Reach safe center, leave ring, or destroy anchor.

spells.name: Mote Dart
spells.effect: 30 m/s dart follows a fixed 15-degree curved approach selected at release, never homes.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1 leaves an audible mote at impact for 1 s.
spells.counterplay: Dodge fixed arc or use cover.

spells.name: Orbital Sentinel
spells.effect: One 45-health wisp orbits caster at 1.5 m for 6 s; shoots visible enemies within 5 m using 16 m/s darts.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; visible/destructible; occupies summon and field allocation.
spells.counterplay: Destroy wisp or stay beyond short reach.

spells.name: Catch Guard
spells.effect: Gain 45 forward shield for 3 s; first 15 absorbed damage turns one existing mote bright without changing damage.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; brightening is information for caster/opponent, no hidden buff.
spells.counterplay: Flank or wait out guard.

spells.name: Shepherd Step
spells.effect: Dash 6 m along a left/right curved ground route, fixed before launch; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1 leaves visible curved trail for 1 s.
spells.counterplay: Attack endpoint or block the curved route.

spells.name: Mote Nest
spells.effect: Place a 35-health 2 m-radius nest for 5 s; all entrants take damage; damage occurs only within line of sight of its center.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; wind shifts loose mote VFX but not server field.
spells.counterplay: Destroy nest or occupy cover inside radius.

spells.name: Tangent Release
spells.effect: Slow 10 m/s orb orbits selected ground point at 2 m radius for 1 s; recast releases it tangentially at 30 m/s.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; orb has 20 health; direction always visible.
spells.counterplay: Shoot orb or read tangent before release.

spells.name: Spirit Lasso
spells.effect: 24 m/s ring projectile pulls hit target 1.5 m sideways in chosen direction over 0.3 s; global control lockout applies.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; cannot pull through solid geometry.
spells.counterplay: Dodge ring or keep solid cover on vulnerable side.

spells.name: Comet Shepherd
spells.effect: Guide a visible 18 m/s comet through at most one manually placed waypoint; waypoint locked after launch.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 3; comet stops at solid surfaces; no target tracking.
spells.counterplay: Read two-segment route or shoot its 35-health core.

spells.name: Root Fan
spells.effect: Three visible ground branches in a 75-degree cone; hit adds 20% slow for 1.5 s; airborne targets avoid branches.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 2; branches die on impact rather than fill entire terrain.
spells.counterplay: Jump, flank cone, or block branches with cover.

spells.name: Thorn Familiar
spells.effect: One 50-health rooted shrub for 7 s attacks visible targets within 4 m with dodgeable 16 m/s thorns.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 2; cannot move, see through fog, or body-block a route.
spells.counterplay: Shoot shrub or fight outside reach.

spells.name: Woven Bark
spells.effect: Gain 50 forward shield for 4 s; caster movement -10%; wood visibly cracks with remaining shield.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1; Heat 1 consumes 10 shield once per cast, water grants no healing.
spells.counterplay: Flank or consume shield while caster is slow.

spells.name: Living Ladder
spells.effect: Grow a 4 m-high, 60-health ladder on visible wall for 7 s; climb costs 8 stamina/s and exposes climber.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 2; water strengthens health by 15 once; heat burns it.
spells.counterplay: Break ladder or aim at predictable climber.

spells.name: Thread Hop
spells.effect: Dash 6 m toward visible ground point; passing within 1 m of own existing growth field costs 18 instead of 22 mana.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1 at endpoint; efficiency benefits capped 20%, no refund.
spells.counterplay: Deny field route or attack fixed endpoint.

spells.name: Bloom Balm
spells.effect: Heal 24 over 3 s; damage during windup cancels cast and refunds only 25% mana; after completion healing persists under global ceiling.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 1 creates a visible 0.5 m bloom for 3 s; no passive area regeneration.
spells.counterplay: Interrupt windup or maintain pressure after partial healing.

spells.name: Worldseed
spells.effect: A visible 1.8 m-radius warning blooms after 0.8 s into 90-health tree for 8 s; trunk 1 m wide, canopy obscures a 3 m radius at 2 m height.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 3; heat destroys canopy at normal damage; trunk cannot block all routes.
spells.counterplay: Leave emergence marker; shoot trunk or use canopy yourself.

spells.name: Predatory Garden
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius field has four 15-health flowers for 6 s; each spits one dodgeable 18 m/s thorn at first visible entrant.
spells.world_interaction: Growth 3 total; flowers share per-target 0.75 s firing interval.
spells.counterplay: Destroy flowers from range or use cover to deny their sight.

spells.name: Tuning Ray
spells.effect: Telegraphed 0.4 m ray; extra deployable damage applies only to visible destructible spell anchors/summons.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; permanent structure unaffected.
spells.counterplay: Break sight during windup.

spells.name: Bass Cleaver
spells.effect: A 90-degree cone deals 10 extra only to deployables; no bonus against shields on players.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1 vibrates props within direct cone.
spells.counterplay: Flank or retreat from visible cone.

spells.name: Phase Shield
spells.effect: Gain 48 shield for 3 s; two visible 0.2 s beats reduce incoming damage 10%, obeying total reduction cap.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; no automatic parry or immunity.
spells.counterplay: Attack between beats or wait out shield.

spells.name: Resonance Probe
spells.effect: 30 m/s bolt hitting deployable reveals its owner 1 s only if owner is within 6 m and direct visible line from prop.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; concealed owners are not detected by proxy.
spells.counterplay: Place constructs away from self or evade bolt.

spells.name: Frequency Slide
spells.effect: Dash 5 m along ground; emit two audible pulses at start and end; route cannot pass solid terrain.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 1; clears no fog and grants no stealth.
spells.counterplay: Track audible endpoint.

spells.name: Null Tone
spells.effect: A narrow visible ray damages one anchor/summon; if destroyed, its normal death effect still occurs, with no silence on owner.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2; never disables equipment or passive buffs.
spells.counterplay: Protect anchor behind cover or interrupt long windup.

spells.name: Overtone Lattice
spells.effect: Two visible 4 m-long sound strings last 5 s, 25 health each; first crossing per target per string causes damage, max 44 total.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 2 shared; strings do not block movement or hide attacks.
spells.counterplay: Jump strings, destroy ends, or cross one only.

spells.name: Construct Requiem
spells.effect: A marked 2.5 m-radius pulse lands after 1 s; deployable bonus applies only to anchors/summons; cover blocks blast.
spells.world_interaction: Sound 3; no penetration after destroying cover on same hit.
spells.counterplay: Exit marker or interrupt windup.

spells.name: Paired Ray
spells.effect: Two 0.25 m rays 0.8 m apart resolve simultaneously after line telegraph; central gap remains.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1 total; mirrors cannot multiply rays.
spells.counterplay: Move through central gap or use cover.

spells.name: Chord Blade
spells.effect: Two visible slash paths cross; either hit deals 36 once, never double damage from intersection.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1 at intersection.
spells.counterplay: Parry or step outside both short arcs.

spells.name: Twin Guard
spells.effect: Create left/right 25-point shields for 4 s, covering 60 degrees each; front 30-degree gap remains; total 50.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; shield health cannot migrate between sides.
spells.counterplay: Aim into front gap or attack one broken side.

spells.name: Handshake Gate
spells.effect: Two 1 m-radius pads <=5 m apart last 5 s; stepping on one grants a one-time 4 m dash toward the other, available to either player.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; 30-health linked anchor; destination must be walkable and route clear.
spells.counterplay: Destroy pad or use route yourself.

spells.name: Interlock Step
spells.effect: Move in two 3 m dash legs with 0.2 s pause; second direction chosen during pause; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Light 1 marks pause point clearly.
spells.counterplay: Attack during pause or deny second route.

spells.name: Concord Beacon
spells.effect: Place two linked 20-health beacons <=4 m apart for 5 s; enemies crossing line with clear beacon sight are revealed 1 s once.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2 total; mist/solid cover breaks detection line.
spells.counterplay: Break either beacon or move under concealment.

spells.name: Counterpoint Mirrors
spells.effect: Create two 30-health mirrors for 5 s; any projectile can reflect once at -30% damage; reflected path is visible; never reflect rays.
spells.world_interaction: Light 2; a projectile cannot bounce from both mirrors.
spells.counterplay: Destroy mirrors or use reflected route yourself.

spells.name: Crown Chord
spells.effect: A visible 6 m-long cross of 1 m-wide beams resolves after 0.8 s; overlap deals damage once.
spells.world_interaction: Light 3; cover stops each beam independently.
spells.counterplay: Move into diagonal gaps or use solid cover.

spells.name: Dusk Dart
spells.effect: 32 m/s dart; hit dims only the target's own spell VFX for 1 s without obscuring opponent tells.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1 on impact; never forces blindness or hides enemy attacks.
spells.counterplay: Dodge dart or use cover.

spells.name: Umbral Hook
spells.effect: A curved 0.6 m-wide slash around either side chosen before windup; cannot pass solid geometry.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1 traced by visible dark-purple edge.
spells.counterplay: Watch selected side, parry, or back out of reach.

spells.name: Nightfold
spells.effect: Create a 4 m-wide, 2.5 m-high veil for 5 s; blocks sight in both directions, no collision or damage.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 2; Light 2 disperses it; wind moves it up to 2 m without extending life.
spells.counterplay: Shoot through, move around, or dispel with light.

spells.name: Hollow Double
spells.effect: Create a 30-health decoy for 5 s; walks one chosen 6 m route and performs harmless cast animation once; translucent within 6 m.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1; no fake damage, collision blocking, or simulated combat sounds beyond footsteps.
spells.counterplay: Recognize translucency or test with a cheap shot.

spells.name: Shade Step
spells.effect: Teleport to visible walkable point <=5 m; gain invisibility 0.75 s; attack, cast, or damage breaks it; departure and arrival remain audible.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1 leaves a 1 m dark puff for 1 s; silhouettes visible within 4 m.
spells.counterplay: Track endpoint sound or damage likely destination.

spells.name: Gloom Stitch
spells.effect: 28 m/s needle; hit adds 16 after 1 s only if target casts during that second; clear tether displays condition.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1 mark; neither silence nor mana drain.
spells.counterplay: Delay one cast or dodge needle.

spells.name: Blackglass Knife
spells.effect: Thrust gains 20% damage only from behind target's facing; combined positional/mastery bonus max 25%.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1 at impact; rear angle measured by server at hit.
spells.counterplay: Keep caster in front, parry, or move laterally.

spells.name: Lantern Snuff
spells.effect: A visible 2 m-radius pulse damages information anchors and removes one Light 1 illumination unit; no player damage.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 2; cannot cancel already applied reveal or disable HUD cues.
spells.counterplay: Place beacon away from others or defend during windup.

spells.name: Tide Hook
spells.effect: 20 m/s tether pulls target up to 2 m toward caster, stopping at geometry; caster cannot move during 0.3 s reel.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1 at impact; tether cannot pass cover.
spells.counterplay: Break line of sight before reel or punish immobile caster.

spells.name: Undertow Disc
spells.effect: 3 m-radius pool lasts 5 s; entrants moving away from center are slowed 20%; never forcibly drags continuously.
spells.world_interaction: Water 2; consumes an existing same-caster pool instead of stacking footprints.
spells.counterplay: Cross center, escape before activation, or change terrain state.

spells.name: Reservoir Mantle
spells.effect: Gain 70 shield for 5 s; lose 15% movement while present; attack or cast drains another 8 shield.
spells.world_interaction: Water 2 released only once on shield expiry/break; creates a 1.5 m puddle for 3 s.
spells.counterplay: Force several casts, then pursue after shield expires.

spells.name: Mist Beads
spells.effect: Lob three beads that create one combined 2.5 m-radius mist field for 5 s after landing.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1; no Wet status; wind clears mist and Heat 1 makes it opaque steam for remaining lifetime.
spells.counterplay: Sound tracks movement; displace the mist with wind.

spells.name: Packet Skip
spells.effect: Dash up to 6 m; recast within 0.5 s can stop early; unused distance grants no refund or extra charge.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1 leaves one 1 m puddle for 3 s at stop point.
spells.counterplay: Read splash route or attack stop point.

spells.name: Purging Splash
spells.effect: Remove one strongest Burn or Corrosion damage-over-time effect from self; gain Wet for 3 s.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1; cannot remove hard control, marks, or direct damage.
spells.counterplay: Bait the cooldown; electricity exploits fresh Wet.

spells.name: Mirror Droplet
spells.effect: Create a 40-health humanoid water decoy for 6 s; repeats last 1 s movement loop; never casts damaging spells.
spells.world_interaction: Water 1 released on destruction; decoy is visibly translucent within 6 m.
spells.counterplay: Read repeated movement or destroy it cheaply.

spells.name: Floodgate Burst
spells.effect: A 4 m-wide ground wave travels 16 m/s; pushes hit targets 3 m once; solid obstacles stop segments.
spells.world_interaction: Water 3 leaves one 12 m-by-3 m connected lane for 5 s.
spells.counterplay: Climb cover, sidestep, or intercept sections with a wall.

spells.name: Razor Return
spells.effect: 22 m/s disc returns along same path after maximum range; at most one hit per leg; solid cover stops it.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 total; no auto-aiming return to moving caster.
spells.counterplay: Sidestep initial line and stay clear of return lane.

spells.name: Rivet Rain
spells.effect: Four clearly marked 1 m impacts inside a 3 m target area fall over 1 s; max three hits per target.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 2 total; markers selected at cast time; no tracking.
spells.counterplay: Move outside pattern or shelter under cover.

spells.name: Painted Guard
spells.effect: Gain a 50-point 90-degree shield for 3 s; shield faces direction selected at cast and never tracks later turns.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1; shield visibly displays its fixed protected arc.
spells.counterplay: Move around fixed shield or force turn.

spells.name: Magnet Pin
spells.effect: 28 m/s pin sticks in a surface for 5 s with 20 health; recast pulls caster 3 m toward it over 0.3 s.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 creates a visible conductivity anchor; no through-wall pull.
spells.counterplay: Destroy pin or watch its short arrival line.

spells.name: Needle Retreat
spells.effect: Dash backward 5 m; leave one visible 15-health needle at start for 3 s, triggered once by entrant within 0.7 m.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1; occupies one field allocation; no slow or root.
spells.counterplay: Destroy needle or avoid marked launch point.

spells.name: Anvil Drop
spells.effect: A 1.5 m-radius floor marker resolves after 0.8 s; overhead solid geometry prevents creation.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 2 leaves a nonblocking conductive plate for 3 s.
spells.counterplay: Exit marker or stand under intact ceiling.

spells.name: Chain Fence
spells.effect: Place a visible 6 m-long, 0.5 m-high, 45-health chain for 6 s; crossing grounded adds 25% slow for 1 s.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 2; each target can retrigger only after 2 s; source remains one field.
spells.counterplay: Jump fence or break its end stakes.

spells.name: Sword Assembly
spells.effect: Summon one 65-health blade construct for 8 s; attacks visible targets within 3 m; move command within 12 m; cannot chase unseen enemies.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 3; occupies one summon and one persistent slot.
spells.counterplay: Break construct, kite its 3 m reach, or block sight.

spells.name: Balance Bolt
spells.effect: 30 m/s bolt checks caster mana before payment; conditional bonus and mastery combined max 25%.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1 at impact; no refund or stolen resource.
spells.counterplay: Dodge bolt or pressure low-mana caster.

spells.name: Countermass Strike
spells.effect: A sweeping half-circle; if caster was pushed within last 2 s, reach increases to 4 m rather than damage.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1; control history server-recorded.
spells.counterplay: Stay beyond improved reach or parry.

spells.name: Scale Guard
spells.effect: Gain 45 shield for 4 s; while shield exists, sprint costs 16 stamina/s instead of 12.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1; no displacement immunity.
spells.counterplay: Force sprint expenditure or wait out shield.

spells.name: Weighted Platform
spells.effect: Raise a 3 m-wide, 1 m-high, 60-health platform for 6 s; stepping on it depresses it 0.5 m over 0.5 s for everyone.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; never crushes, launches, or traps players beneath it.
spells.counterplay: Break platform or contest depressed height.

spells.name: Fulcrum Step
spells.effect: Dash 6 m sideways about a chosen visible ground pivot <=6 m; fixed circular route stops at geometry.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 1; pivot is audible/visible during windup.
spells.counterplay: Attack curved endpoint or block arc.

spells.name: Equalize Field
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius field lasts 5 s; all occupants receive 10% reduction and -10% speed; reductions obey global cap.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; 45-health anchor; no damage redistribution between players.
spells.counterplay: Fight outside radius or destroy anchor.

spells.name: Tipping Point
spells.effect: A 6 m-long seesaw line erupts after 0.7 s; targets on selected half pushed 2 m, other half pushed 1 m opposite; once per target.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 2; pushes obey control immunity and stop at walls.
spells.counterplay: Step off visible line or choose safer side.

spells.name: Orbit Exchange
spells.effect: Throw 18 m/s orb to ground; recast within 1 s moves self up to 6 m toward impact and bursts 1.5 m there; no target swaps.
spells.world_interaction: Gravity 3; if route blocked, burst still occurs but movement cancels.
spells.counterplay: Block movement route or dodge orb endpoint.

spells.name: Quake Heel
spells.effect: 2.5 m-radius grounded pulse; 15% slow for 1 s; airborne targets avoid it.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1 shakes fragile props but cannot collapse arena structure.
spells.counterplay: Jump at visible stomp or stay outside radius.

spells.name: Boulder Bowl
spells.effect: A 1 m-wide, 45-health boulder rolls 10 m/s along ground; one target hit then shatters; jumps avoid it.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; strikes destructible prop for normal physical damage.
spells.counterplay: Jump, sidestep, or destroy the slow boulder.

spells.name: Bedrock Brace
spells.effect: For 4 s gain 12% physical reduction and halve displacement distance; movement speed -10%; no control immunity.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1 anchors feet visually; normal dash/teleport clears brace.
spells.counterplay: Use nonphysical damage or disengage while caster slows.

spells.name: Sinkstone
spells.effect: Place a 2.5 m-radius sinking tile for 5 s; 20% slow for entrants; no immobilization or underground trapping.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; water turns dust to mud without adding slow intensity.
spells.counterplay: Shoot its 45-health anchor or cross by jumping.

spells.name: Moss Route
spells.effect: A 8 m-by-2 m path lasts 5 s; all grounded entrants get +10% speed and 20% lower jump stamina cost, capped by mastery efficiency rules.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1 and Growth 1; heat removes moss benefit while earth remains nonblocking.
spells.counterplay: Use route yourself or burn its surface.

spells.name: Stone Orbit
spells.effect: Three visible stones orbit within 1 m for 4 s; each can block 18 incoming projectile damage or hit once on contact.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2 total; stones do not intercept rays or melee.
spells.counterplay: Use beams, break stones, or bait contact then withdraw.

spells.name: Seismic Echo
spells.effect: A ground pulse exposes silhouettes for 1.5 s only of grounded targets within 16 m and clear connected ground; caster is also audible at 24 m.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2 pulse; elevated bridges and separated platforms block propagation.
spells.counterplay: Jump on pulse timing or change ground platform.

spells.name: Mountain Exchange
spells.effect: For 5 s gain 80 shield and -15% speed; dash and teleport spells drain 20 remaining shield when used.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2 on expiry makes a 1 m dust puff for 1 s; no lasting rock shell.
spells.counterplay: Kite reduced movement or force reposition costs.

spells.name: Future Needle
spells.effect: 42 m/s glass needle travels toward manually selected aim point; no tracking or prediction assistance.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1 on impact; Heat can fuse residue into nonblocking glass.
spells.counterplay: Dodge narrow shot or force a last-moment aim change.

spells.name: Crossing Shot
spells.effect: Fire one 32 m/s bolt now and one from original position 0.6 s later along a second manually chosen line.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1 total; delayed bolt stops on any new obstruction.
spells.counterplay: Read both marked lines or deny original launch point.

spells.name: Forecast Guard
spells.effect: After 0.5 s delay gain 50 fixed-forward shield for 3 s; its orientation selected at cast, never follows later aim.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1; visible hourglass announces shield arrival.
spells.counterplay: Attack before arrival or from unprotected side.

spells.name: Glass Horizon
spells.effect: A 4 m-wide, 2 m-high, 55-health frosted glass screen lasts 6 s; blocks sight and projectiles but not sound.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 2; Heat 1 clears opacity without removing collision; impact damage can break glass.
spells.counterplay: Break screen or exploit heat-cleared transparency.

spells.name: Parallax Step
spells.effect: Dash sideways 6 m after a visible 0.3 s delay; direction selected during windup; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 1 departure puff lasts 1 s and never hides launch tell.
spells.counterplay: Attack delayed launch or guard endpoint.

spells.name: Dust Prediction
spells.effect: A marked 2.5 m patch activates after 1 s for 5 s; everyone crossing is slowed 20%; no auto-targeting.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 2; Water turns it to mud with same slow; Wind removes one unit.
spells.counterplay: Leave warning or disperse patch.

spells.name: Sand Hourglass
spells.effect: A visible 25-health hourglass lasts 6 s; first entrant within 1 m starts 0.6 s warning then 1.5 m burst; target can escape.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 2; Heat fuses trap inertly, Water consumes its trigger.
spells.counterplay: Shoot trap or leave during countdown.

spells.name: Dune Verdict
spells.effect: Choose two 1.5 m-radius markers; after 1 s only manually selected marker erupts; selection locks 0.3 s before blast.
spells.world_interaction: Sand 3; both candidates readable; blast cannot penetrate intact cover.
spells.counterplay: Move outside both candidates or shelter.

spells.name: Velocity Bolt
spells.effect: 34 m/s bolt inherits caster lateral velocity up to 3 m/s; no added damage from speed.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1 on impact; inherited trajectory visibly consistent.
spells.counterplay: Predict moving launch or use cover.

spells.name: Crosscut Vector
spells.effect: A 90-degree slash oriented along current lateral motion; standing uses facing; hit pushes 1 m once.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1; no momentum damage scaling.
spells.counterplay: Stop or reverse caster approach, parry arc.

spells.name: Momentum Guard
spells.effect: Gain 45 shield for 4 s while moving; staying below 1 m/s for 0.5 s removes shield; no resource refund.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1; shield does not change hitbox or confer avoidance.
spells.counterplay: Block route or force caster to stop.

spells.name: Vector Ramp
spells.effect: Place a 3 m-long, 2 m-wide energy ramp for 5 s; grounded entrants get one 2 m-high launch along indicated arrow per 2 s.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2; 35-health anchor; no midair relaunch.
spells.counterplay: Avoid arrow or aim at predictable landing.

spells.name: Drift Dash
spells.effect: Dash 7 m; one manual 20-degree direction correction allowed halfway; total distance still <=7 m.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1 draws both trajectory segments visibly.
spells.counterplay: Hold endpoint angle or block corrected route.

spells.name: Wake Marker
spells.effect: Place a visible 8 m-by-1.5 m trail for 5 s; all players crossing perpendicular gain +10% speed for 1 s, no refresh within same cast.
spells.world_interaction: Force 1; no cooldown/stamina refund.
spells.counterplay: Use trail yourself or deny its exits.

spells.name: Brake Trap
spells.effect: A 25-health 1 m trap lasts 6 s; first grounded entrant over 4 m/s takes damage and 25% slow for 1 s; walking does not trigger.
spells.world_interaction: Force 2; visible speed chevrons; no hard stop.
spells.counterplay: Walk across, jump, or shoot trap.

spells.name: Acceleration Line
spells.effect: Dash 8 m with visible buildup; hit only first target within 1 m path, ending travel; miss recovery 0.4 s.
spells.world_interaction: Force 3; no damage multiplication from actual movement speed.
spells.counterplay: Sidestep fixed line or intercept with cover.

spells.name: Ritual Arrow
spells.effect: 30 m/s arrow; after caster crossed own existing circle within 2 s, projectile can pass that circle once at +10% speed.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; no damage or range bonus; still stops on cover.
spells.counterplay: Avoid visible launch lane or deny caster circle.

spells.name: Circle Scythe
spells.effect: A 180-degree slash centered on facing; while inside own ritual circle width becomes 0.8 m instead of 0.5 m.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; no extra damage from wider arc.
spells.counterplay: Flank rear half or force fight away from circle.

spells.name: Pilgrim Ward
spells.effect: Gain 40 shield for 4 s; passing through own circle during it restores 10 shield once, still <=50 total absorption.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; no healing or repeated regeneration.
spells.counterplay: Break shield before circle crossing or guard route.

spells.name: Witness Circle
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius circle lasts 6 s with 35-health anchor; all entrants' footsteps create readable edge ripples without revealing through cover.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; counts as ritual circle for this kit; opaque fields still conceal players.
spells.counterplay: Destroy anchor or avoid noisy crossing.

spells.name: Procession Step
spells.effect: Dash 6 m; if route crosses own circle, endpoint emits 1 m harmless obscuring puff for 1 s; route and endpoint remain audible.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 1; no invisibility or invulnerability.
spells.counterplay: Guard endpoint or deny circle route.

spells.name: Spirit Waymark
spells.effect: Place 30-health ritual circle anchor for 6 s; recast moves self up to 5 m toward it, with clear route; consumes anchor.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2; does not teleport through cover or grant spell swaps.
spells.counterplay: Destroy anchor or track approach.

spells.name: Ancestor Pair
spells.effect: Summon two 30-health wisps at endpoints 4 m apart for 6 s; each fires 16 m/s bolts only within 3 m and visible sight.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 2 shared; fills two summon slots and one field allocation.
spells.counterplay: Destroy one endpoint or fight outside small ranges.

spells.name: Completed Rite
spells.effect: A 2.5 m-radius warning resolves after 0.8 s; if caster crossed own circle in last 2 s, warning narrows to 2 m and damage stays 54.
spells.world_interaction: Spirit 3; reduced area supports accurate positioning rather than bonus damage.
spells.counterplay: Exit marker or deny setup crossing.

spells.name: Etched Edge
spells.effect: Choose vertical or horizontal 0.6 m-wide slash before windup; vertical can hit airborne targets but has narrower lateral coverage.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 sparks on contacted surface.
spells.counterplay: Read engraved orientation, parry, or leave plane.

spells.name: Arc Rivet
spells.effect: 34 m/s rivet follows one manually chosen quarter-circle bend up to 20 degrees; curve locked before launch.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 becomes temporary conductive dot for 2 s.
spells.counterplay: Read curve or place cover in its route.

spells.name: Engraved Guard
spells.effect: Gain 50 shield for 4 s in chosen vertical 60-degree arc or horizontal 120-degree arc with 0.8 m height; never both.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1; shield shape visible; no full-body coverage.
spells.counterplay: Aim outside chosen height/angle.

spells.name: Metal Calligraphy
spells.effect: Draw one visible 6 m-long, 1 m-wide conductive strip for 6 s; touching wet tiles may connect only across this exact intact strip.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 2; strip has 35 health and no damage/slow by itself.
spells.counterplay: Break strip or move off connected route.

spells.name: Chisel Dash
spells.effect: Dash two fixed 3 m legs at a chosen 90-degree corner; stops at first collision; no midroute invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 1 shows engraved corner point during windup.
spells.counterplay: Guard corner or block first leg.

spells.name: Contour Cage
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius wire ring lasts 5 s with 40-health hub; first crossing per player causes damage and 15% slow for 1 s.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 2; ring never blocks walking/jumping; no repeat hit per same cast.
spells.counterplay: Jump wire, destroy hub, or avoid crossing.

spells.name: Ferric Signature
spells.effect: 28 m/s blade leaves a 20-health surface glyph; recast within 2 s sends one 18-damage 20 m/s shard along initial return line.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 2 total; glyph cannot auto-aim or fire through walls.
spells.counterplay: Break glyph or leave return line.

spells.name: Sculpted Blade
spells.effect: One 60-health floating blade lasts 7 s; follows an explicitly drawn 6 m path, striking visible targets within 2 m; cannot chase.
spells.world_interaction: Metal 3; one summon and field allocation; path is readable.
spells.counterplay: Destroy blade or avoid its path.

spells.name: Venom Dart
spells.effect: 32 m/s dart; Corrosion strongest only, duration refreshes; no armor bypass.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 1 at impact; water dilutes ground residue, not an already applied wound.
spells.counterplay: Dodge dart or cleanse Corrosion.

spells.name: Covenant Fang
spells.effect: May pay 8 extra health at cast to widen thrust from 0.5 m to 0.9 m; no damage increase; cannot pledge below 9 health.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 1 on contact; payment cannot proc damage/refund effects.
spells.counterplay: Parry or bait widened miss.

spells.name: Red Guard
spells.effect: Pay 12 health to gain 55 shield for 4 s; payment cannot be reduced; cannot cast below 13 health.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 1 creates visible red shell; no healing on expiry.
spells.counterplay: Wait out shield or punish already wounded caster.

spells.name: Bile Pool
spells.effect: A 2.5 m-radius pool lasts 5 s; damage all entrants at 0.5 s ticks; no automatic healing reduction.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 2; Water consumes one unit per unit; Heat burns residue into harmless smoke for 2 s.
spells.counterplay: Leave pool or dilute it.

spells.name: Pledge Leap
spells.effect: Leap to visible ground point <=6 m and <=2 m higher; optional 8-health pledge reduces mana to 18, within efficiency cap.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 1 on landing; no damaging landing or invulnerability.
spells.counterplay: Track airborne arc or punish health trade.

spells.name: Antidote Vow
spells.effect: Cleanse one Corrosion or Bleed effect and heal 16 over 2 s; during windup caster cannot sprint; global healing ceiling applies.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 1 is consumed by cleansing; no automatic immunity after cast.
spells.counterplay: Interrupt windup or reapply pressure.

spells.name: Sanguine Seal
spells.effect: Place 25-health trap for 6 s; first entrant within 1 m triggers after 0.4 s warning; optional 10-health pledge enlarges burst 1.2 m to 1.8 m.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 2; no damage/healing amplification from pledge.
spells.counterplay: Destroy trap or leave warning radius.

spells.name: Debt Collector
spells.effect: 24 m/s orb; caster may pay 10 health to split it into two 30-damage arcs, max 54 total per target; no homing.
spells.world_interaction: Venom 3 total; pledge adds coverage and changes trajectory, no extra single-target damage.
spells.counterplay: Use arc gap or destroy 30-health unsplit orb.

spells.name: Quietus Needle
spells.effect: 30 m/s needle silences hit target for 0.5 s; hard-control lockout applies; does not stop common movement or weapons.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1; line requires unobstructed travel.
spells.counterplay: Dodge thin needle or pressure while caster winds up.

spells.name: Nocturne Fork
spells.effect: Two 20 m/s orbs diverge then curve along fixed visible arcs; curves are chosen at cast time, never home onto players.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 3 total; each stops on solid surfaces.
spells.counterplay: Move into arc gap or interpose cover.

spells.name: Midnight Exchange
spells.effect: Pay 20 health to gain 60 shield for 4 s; after shield breaks gain 1 s invisibility, broken by attack/cast/damage; health minimum 21.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 2; shield and disappearance both audible and visibly telegraphed.
spells.counterplay: Force invisibility early and track wounded caster.

spells.name: Penumbra Trap
spells.effect: Place a visible 25-health rune for 6 s; first entrant within 1 m takes damage and 20% slow for 1 s.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 2 makes rune dark, but mandatory violet rim remains readable at all graphics settings.
spells.counterplay: Shoot rune, leap over, or use light to consume its source.

spells.name: Shadow Anchor
spells.effect: Place a 35-health anchor for 6 s; recast teleports self back only if within 8 m and route has no solid obstruction; ending destroys anchor.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 2; uses a persistent slot; arrival flash and sound reveal destination.
spells.counterplay: Destroy anchor or guard its location.

spells.name: Eclipse Mantle
spells.effect: Gain invisibility for 1.5 s, broken by attack/cast/damage; movement speed -10%; silhouette visible within 4 m.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 2; audible movement remains; no field hides the endpoint.
spells.counterplay: Use sound, close distance, or land area damage.

spells.name: Darkroom
spells.effect: A 4 m-radius opaque dome lasts 6 s; entering either way makes a clear chime; close silhouettes visible within 4 m.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 3; 60-health anchor; no silence, damage immunity, or hidden projectile absorption.
spells.counterplay: Destroy anchor, listen to crossings, or use the dome yourself.

spells.name: Conditional Escape
spells.effect: If self has shield at commitment, dash 6 m; otherwise teleport 4 m to visible walkable point; chosen result shown before release.
spells.world_interaction: Shadow 1 at departure; no invisibility or opponent-state targeting.
spells.counterplay: Read declared branch and guard endpoint.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.effect: 36 m/s projectile; impact applies 15% slow for 1 s.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 1 freezes a thin Water 1 patch at impact.
spells.counterplay: Dodge the lance; cover absorbs it.

spells.name: Rime Knuckle
spells.effect: A gauntlet strike; against Wet target add 20% slow for 1.5 s instead of the normal 10% for 1 s.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 1 dries Wet into visible surface rime.
spells.counterplay: Parry or kite the short reach.

spells.name: Crystal Guard
spells.effect: For 3 s, forward 100-degree shield absorbs 45 damage; a common parry during it adds 0.25 s to shield duration once.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 1 on break; never expands parry timing or reflects automatically.
spells.counterplay: Attack from side/back or outlast the shield.

spells.name: Permafrost Tile
spells.effect: Freeze a 3 m-radius patch for 6 s; ground acceleration/deceleration reduced 20% for everyone on it.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 2; wet patches freeze; heat restores traction; sprint speed unchanged.
spells.counterplay: Walk deliberately, jump off, or melt the tile.

spells.name: Glacier Shoulder
spells.effect: Dash up to 6 m with 30 temporary forward shield during travel; end collision pushes 1.5 m; no invulnerability.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 1 at endpoint; no shield after dash.
spells.counterplay: Flank path, break shield, or dodge endpoint.

spells.name: Ice Bridge
spells.effect: Create a 6 m-by-2 m, 60-health slab attached to reachable terrain for 6 s; max height difference 2 m.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 2; heat melts slab; it cannot seal spawns or extend beyond boundary.
spells.counterplay: Break supporting slab or contest its accessible endpoints.

spells.name: Cold Snap
spells.effect: 26 m/s bolt roots Wet or already slowed targets for 0.5 s; others receive 20% slow for 1.5 s.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 2 consumes Wet; hard-control immunity applies.
spells.counterplay: Remove Wet, evade bolt, or exploit caster windup.

spells.name: Frozen Reprisal
spells.effect: For 3 s absorb 20% of direct damage, max 24; recast shoots a 30 m/s shard with stored amount; expiry discards storage.
spells.world_interaction: Frost 1 on shard impact; absorption obeys total reduction cap.
spells.counterplay: Wait out storage or dodge the obvious retaliation shard.

spells.name: Witness Stone
spells.effect: 30 m/s stone; if self landed from jump within 1 s, one ground bounce is allowed at 24 damage.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1; event server-recorded; no bonus damage from hopping repeatedly.
spells.counterplay: Read landing tell or block bank path.

spells.name: Oath Knuckle
spells.effect: A forward fist; within 1 s of common guard ending, strike arc widens from 0.6 m to 1 m, damage unchanged.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1; one event use per cast.
spells.counterplay: Bait guard release or stay beyond reach.

spells.name: Event Guard
spells.effect: Gain 45 shield for 3 s; next completed self jump landing emits harmless 1 m dust puff for 1 s once.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1; no extra shield, healing, or hidden landing.
spells.counterplay: Attack while airborne or after shield expires.

spells.name: Binding Cairn
spells.effect: Place a 30-health cairn for 6 s; arms after first projectile impacts within 2 m; next entrant within 1 m triggers 0.5 s warning then burst.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; either player can arm it; mandatory state glow.
spells.counterplay: Avoid armed cairn or destroy before triggering.

spells.name: Followthrough Step
spells.effect: Dash 6 m; within 1 s of common melee hitting, mana cost is 18, subject to 20% total casting-efficiency cap.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 1 at endpoint; no extra dash charges or reset.
spells.counterplay: Deny melee confirm or guard dash endpoint.

spells.name: Impact Clause
spells.effect: Create a visible 6 m-by-1 m line for 2 s; first nearby solid projectile impact within 2 m triggers it after 0.5 s; otherwise expires harmlessly.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; either player's impact can trigger; one field allocation.
spells.counterplay: Avoid line, prevent impact, or trigger from safety.

spells.name: Transition Ring
spells.effect: A 3 m ring lasts 5 s; first grounded entrant who begins sprint inside triggers one 2 m burst after 0.4 s warning.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 2; walking/jumping do not trigger; both players affected.
spells.counterplay: Walk carefully, leave warning, or break 40-health anchor.

spells.name: Lasting Oath
spells.effect: Declare one 2 m-radius marker lasting 3 s; next self common parry success triggers eruption after 0.7 s; recast can trigger at 40 damage without parry.
spells.world_interaction: Earth 3; visible dormant/armed states; never auto-targets opponent.
spells.counterplay: Leave marker, bait missed parry, or pressure before trigger.

spells.name: Ember Needle
spells.effect: 45 m/s narrow projectile; precision bonus requires a head or marked weak point.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1 affects only a 0.4 m impact spot.
spells.counterplay: Small hitbox; cover breaks the shot.

spells.name: Furnace Breath
spells.effect: Cone channel costs another 8 mana/s; movement -20%; tick each 0.5 s; release ends channel.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1 per second, maximum Heat 2 from this cast; removes thin fog locally.
spells.counterplay: Interrupt channel, move behind caster, or deny its short range.

spells.name: Coalheart Exchange
spells.effect: Pay 25 health, which cannot be reduced; gain 20 mana and +10% thermal damage for 4 s; cannot cast below 26 health.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1 dries self once; no healing or passive resource generation.
spells.counterplay: Pressure the health sacrifice and disengage during the visible buff.

spells.name: Kiln Ring
spells.effect: A 3 m-radius ring, 0.6 m thick, lasts 6 s; center remains clear; ticks each 0.5 s.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 2 on ring tiles; consumes local liquids instead of following their spread.
spells.counterplay: Jump or cross quickly; fight from inside the clear center.

spells.name: Ember Drift
spells.effect: Dash 6 m along one manually chosen 20-degree curve; leave one 1 m Heat 1 patch at endpoint for 3 s dealing 4/s to all entrants.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1; reacts with only endpoint water, never entire path.
spells.counterplay: Read curved route and avoid heated endpoint.

spells.name: Scorch Brand
spells.effect: 28 m/s bolt marks hit target; second damage after 1.5 s only if target stayed within 6 m of impact position.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 1 on initial contact; moving ends the second damage.
spells.counterplay: Move outside the clearly displayed anchor radius.

spells.name: Molten Step
spells.effect: Turn one 2 m-radius ground patch molten for 5 s; no permanent excavation.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 3 consumes water/frost there; Earth 2 or water cools it into walkable crust.
spells.counterplay: Avoid the bright patch or cool it with a reaction.

spells.name: Sunfall Mortar
spells.effect: Ground-targeted arc lands after 1.2 s; 1.5 m inner and 3 m outer radii; requires initial sight.
spells.world_interaction: Heat 3 over outer area; cover blocks blast by surface checks.
spells.counterplay: Leave the ground marker or reach solid cover.

equipment.name: Surveyor's Point
equipment.effect: After aiming without sprinting for 0.6 s, the next direct projectile travels 10% faster. If no projectile spell is equipped, the prepared cast instead gains 5% shorter preparation.
equipment.drawback: Moving faster than walk cancels preparation.
equipment.counterplay: Break sight during preparation.

equipment.name: Glass Needle
equipment.effect: Direct projectile hits within 0.2 m of a head weak point gain 10% damage; total precision multiplier remains capped at 1.25. If no projectile spell is equipped, perfect guard grants 3 stamina once per 4 s.
equipment.drawback: Other projectile impacts deal 5% less damage.
equipment.counterplay: Change elevation and avoid predictable motion.

equipment.name: Loopwood Switch
equipment.effect: Switching to a different equipped spell reduces that spell's next paid mana cost by 3 after 1 s; 4 s internal cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Repeated casts of the same spell cost 2 more mana.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure during the enforced rotation.

equipment.name: Chisel Wand
equipment.effect: Direct spell damage removes 12 additional health from destructible cover, once per cast.
equipment.drawback: Direct player spell damage decreases 3%.
equipment.counterplay: Fight away from fragile cover.

equipment.name: Quiet Reed
equipment.effect: Standing still for 0.8 s reduces the next spell release sound audible range by 20%; spoken cadence remains fully audible at normal range.
equipment.drawback: The first 0.3 s of movement after casting is slowed 10%.
equipment.counterplay: Watch cast flashes and punish stationary preparation.

equipment.name: Counterweight Sprig
equipment.effect: A spell cast within 0.4 s after landing costs 10% less mana.
equipment.drawback: Airborne casts cost 5% more mana.
equipment.counterplay: Attack the landing point.

equipment.name: Forked Hazel
equipment.effect: A single projectile may split into two at 5 m, each carrying 45% of original direct damage and half field strength; spread 8 degrees. If no projectile spell is equipped, focus input grants 8 shield for 1 s instead.
equipment.activation: Focus input, 5 mana, 12 s cooldown; primed for next eligible projectile within 4 s
equipment.drawback: Total direct damage falls 10%; cannot split chains, beams or split projectiles.
equipment.counterplay: Use cover or move between the visible branches.

equipment.name: Mercy Prong
equipment.effect: Direct spell damage to an enemy below 90 health grants a 10-health shield for 2 s; 6 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Direct spell damage against enemies above 240 health decreases 3%.
equipment.counterplay: Keep health above the threshold or break the short shield.

equipment.name: Venom Quill
equipment.effect: Direct spell hits against shields add 6 damage to that shield only; once per cast.
equipment.drawback: Direct spell damage against unshielded enemies decreases 3%.
equipment.counterplay: Drop the shield before impact or evade the dart.

equipment.name: Palmwood Rod
equipment.effect: Casting within 3 m of the enemy grants 6 stamina after paid release; 3 s internal cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Spell damage beyond 15 m is reduced 5%.
equipment.counterplay: Kite beyond 3 m.

equipment.name: Threadcatcher
equipment.effect: Hit with 3 different paid spells within 5 s: the third hit adds 8 arcane proc damage, 8 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Missing the third cast removes progress; proc damage cannot trigger other effects.
equipment.counterplay: Break sight before the third direct hit.

equipment.name: Hollow Acorn
equipment.effect: Paid spells cost 5% less mana when no living summon is owned.
