equipment.drawback: While owning a living summon, spells cost 2 additional mana.
equipment.counterplay: Destroy the first summon and pressure during cooldown.

equipment.name: Return Address
equipment.effect: One direct projectile that misses returns along its exact path, dealing 40% original damage on its first return hit; consumes projectile on hit. If no projectile spell is equipped, focus input reduces next guard cost by 5 stamina instead.
equipment.activation: Focus input, 12 mana, 18 s cooldown; prime next projectile within 4 s
equipment.drawback: Outbound projectile deals 10% less damage; cannot return a ricochet, split, chain or proc projectile.
equipment.counterplay: Step off the visibly marked return path.

equipment.name: Broken Crown Wand
equipment.effect: A paid cast below 75 health grants 20 shield for 2 s; 10 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana decreases 10.
equipment.counterplay: Close using cover and movement.

equipment.name: Sovereign Switch
equipment.effect: After hitting with 3 different equipped spells within 5 s, reduce one currently cooling spell by 1 s, once per 8 s.
equipment.drawback: Missing the third spell consumes the 8 s opportunity; secondary hits do not count.
equipment.counterplay: Evade the third distinct spell.

equipment.name: Pilgrim's Crook
equipment.effect: Walking for 2 s without sprinting makes the next paid spell cost 4 less mana.
equipment.drawback: Sprinting resets preparation.
equipment.counterplay: Force repeated sprints and abrupt engagements.

equipment.name: Riverkeeper
equipment.effect: While standing on wet ground, paid spell preparation decreases 5%.
equipment.drawback: Leaving wet ground keeps the wearer wet 0.5 s longer.
equipment.counterplay: Displace the caster or evaporate the patch.

equipment.name: Breaker Bar
equipment.effect: Common staff strike removes 25 additional health from destructible props; cycle and player damage remain baseline.
equipment.drawback: Common strike costs 2 extra stamina.
equipment.counterplay: Fight outside staff reach.

equipment.name: Watchtower Staff
equipment.effect: After standing grounded for 0.8 s, a paid cast grants 12 shield for 2 s; 6 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Walking speed during spell preparation decreases 5%.
equipment.counterplay: Flank or force the beam to stop.

equipment.name: Survey Staff
equipment.effect: Non-damaging paid spells cost 5% less mana; placement preview distance increases 3 m without increasing cast range.
equipment.drawback: Damaging spells cost 1 additional mana.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure during the extended preparation.

equipment.name: Magnet Walker
equipment.effect: Move visible loose metal props within 3 m up to 1 m toward a chosen ground point; no player pull or damage.
equipment.drawback: The 0.5 s channel prevents sprint and emits a metal chime.
equipment.counterplay: Interrupt the channel or avoid the gathered props.

equipment.name: Stone Choir
equipment.effect: A paid spell cast adjacent to owned destructible cover repairs 12 health on that cover, once per cast; never above initial health.
equipment.drawback: All paid spells cost 1 additional mana.
equipment.counterplay: Apply sustained cover damage or flank it.

equipment.name: Wetline Spindle
equipment.effect: Dodge costs 3 less stamina when wearer stands on wet terrain.
equipment.drawback: Dodge on dry terrain costs 1 additional stamina.
equipment.counterplay: Read the visible destination and punish the extra cost.

equipment.name: Umbra Mast
equipment.effect: Standing inside steam or opaque sand grants 10% bonus mana regeneration after ordinary delay.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina falls 10.
equipment.counterplay: Clear the cloud or apply pressure through it.

equipment.name: Clockroot Staff
equipment.effect: First direct paid spell hit each 10 s grants 10 shield for 1.5 s.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina decreases 6.
equipment.counterplay: Leave the field or destroy its source.

equipment.name: Pressure Lantern
equipment.effect: Casting a paid spell in steam clears a 1 m-wide corridor up to 4 m along aim direction for 1 s, consuming up to 1 steam strength.
equipment.drawback: That spell direct damage decreases 5%.
equipment.counterplay: Close before the cast finishes.

equipment.name: Pressure Valve
equipment.effect: Casting Force on steam clears a 2 m corridor through it for 1 s, along the original spell path. If no Force spell is equipped, a paid spell hitting a destructible prop adds 5 prop damage once per cast.
equipment.drawback: Force direct damage falls 5%.
equipment.counterplay: Move across the corridor instead of along it.

equipment.name: Worldseed
equipment.effect: Next field spreads from an existing visible field edge up to 2 m, retaining normal total area/strength budget and max 8 s lifetime. If no field spell is equipped, focus input instead grants 10 shield for 1.5 s.
equipment.drawback: Field initial damage decreases 15%; both modes share 18 s cooldown.
equipment.counterplay: Destroy or leave the original field edge.

equipment.name: Moon Gate
equipment.effect: Create two visible 1 m portal ends at visible points at most 4 m apart for 3 s. Only next own straight projectile transfers between them, preserving speed, lifetime and damage. If no projectile spell is equipped, focus input instead grants 15 shield for 2 s.
equipment.activation: Focus input, 15 mana, 20 s cooldown; portal lasts 3 s
equipment.drawback: Portal ends glow; cannot transfer beams, chains, transformed projectiles or players; both modes share 20 s cooldown.
equipment.counterplay: Guard the exit or wait out 3 s.

equipment.name: Last Campfire
equipment.effect: Below 100 health, a paid nondamaging spell grants 20 shield for 2 s; 12 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health falls 15.
equipment.counterplay: Chase into the new field before the trigger condition succeeds.

equipment.name: Apprentice Dagger
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; cycle is 0.72 s instead of 0.8 s, stamina remains 12.
equipment.drawback: Reach falls to 1.6 m.
equipment.counterplay: Keep more than 1.6 m spacing.

equipment.name: Arena Saber
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; reach is 2 m instead of 1.8 m.
equipment.drawback: Cycle increases to 0.88 s.
equipment.counterplay: Punish the longer recovery.

equipment.name: Runic Falchion
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; a strike within 2 s after any paid spell adds 4 arcane damage, once per cast.
equipment.drawback: Base strike damage falls 2.
equipment.counterplay: Guard the charged strike.

equipment.name: Gutter Pike
equipment.effect: Spear profile; stamina cost falls to 14 from 16.
equipment.drawback: Damage falls from 32 to 30.
equipment.counterplay: Advance after the spear misses.

equipment.name: Basalt Maul
equipment.effect: Heavy profile; direct strike damages destructible cover for 20 extra health.
equipment.drawback: Stamina cost rises from 20 to 23.
equipment.counterplay: Use spacing instead of relying on fragile cover.

equipment.name: Heatbrand
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; striking a burning enemy adds 4 thermal damage once per 0.5 s.
equipment.drawback: Blade has a visible ember trail; wetness removes its bonus until next cast.
equipment.counterplay: Extinguish burning or guard the strike.

equipment.name: Rainhook
equipment.effect: Spear profile; striking a wet enemy restores 3 stamina once per 1 s.
equipment.drawback: Dry-target strike damage falls 3.
equipment.counterplay: Leave water before the exchange.

equipment.name: Glass Rapier
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; perfectly guarding then striking within 0.6 s adds 4 damage.
equipment.drawback: Strikes after ordinary guard deal 2 less damage.
equipment.counterplay: Feint the opening attack.

equipment.name: Ice Cleaver
equipment.effect: Heavy profile; strikes against ice props deal 25 additional prop damage.
equipment.drawback: Player strike damage falls 3.
equipment.counterplay: Avoid hiding behind ice near the wielder.

equipment.name: Copper Trident
equipment.effect: Spear profile; direct hits apply conductive tag for 1 s, which does not deal damage or count as wetness.
equipment.drawback: Spear stamina cost rises 2.
equipment.counterplay: Break the follow-up Storm cast.

equipment.name: Sunsteel Glaive
equipment.effect: Spear profile; a direct spell hit followed by spear hit within 2 s grants 12 shield for 1.5 s; 6 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Spear damage falls 2.
equipment.counterplay: Avoid the follow-up strike until the mark expires.

equipment.name: Root Hunter Blade
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; destroying an enemy summon restores 5 stamina once per 4 s.
equipment.drawback: Owner's successful strikes are audible 4 m farther.
equipment.counterplay: Move after impact and track the chime.

equipment.name: Pugilist's Focus
equipment.effect: Light blade profile with 1.4 m reach; a paid spell within 0.4 s after strike costs 3 less mana.
equipment.drawback: Weapon range is shortened.
equipment.counterplay: Deny the initial short-range contact.

equipment.name: Unenchanted Longsword
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; base damage is 30 instead of 28.
equipment.drawback: Cycle is 0.88 s and it adds no school tags.
equipment.counterplay: Punish slower recoveries.

equipment.name: Doorbreaker Axe
equipment.effect: Heavy profile; striking an enemy guard removes 6 additional stamina without bypassing damage reduction.
equipment.drawback: Unguarded-target damage falls 4.
equipment.counterplay: Dodge the heavy strike instead of guarding repeatedly.

equipment.name: Mirror Bucklerblade
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; successful perfect guard grants 8 shield for 1 s, 4 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina falls 8.
equipment.counterplay: Feint the guard and attack after 1 s.

equipment.name: Counterspell Estoc
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; a strike during enemy cast preparation removes 6 mana, once per 4 s; cannot reduce below 0.
equipment.drawback: Base strike damage falls 4; no silence or automatic cancellation.
equipment.counterplay: Cast beyond blade reach or guard first.

equipment.name: Anchor Hammer
equipment.effect: Heavy profile; recoil and enemy push affecting owner during a swing are reduced 15%.
equipment.drawback: Walking speed while winding the swing falls 15%.
equipment.counterplay: Circle the slow windup.

equipment.name: Spellweave Chain
equipment.effect: Spear profile with 2.5 m reach; hitting with melee then two different spells within 4 s grants 8 stamina once per 8 s.
equipment.drawback: All strikes cost 2 more stamina.
equipment.counterplay: Evade either spell in the chain.

equipment.name: Phoenix Edge
equipment.effect: Light blade profile; below 80 health, direct strike lifesteal is 6%, within 10% and 20 healing/s global caps.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health falls 20; no healing from procs, props or summons.
equipment.counterplay: Keep distance until the healing opportunity expires.

equipment.name: Training Cuirass
equipment.effect: Maximum health increases 15.
equipment.drawback: Sprint stamina consumption increases 1/s.
equipment.counterplay: Force long pursuits.

equipment.name: Riveted Vest
equipment.effect: Physical resistance increases 8 percentage points, within 35% channel cap.
equipment.drawback: Mana regeneration decreases 5%.
equipment.counterplay: Use other damage channels.

equipment.name: Kilnplate
equipment.effect: Thermal resistance increases 12 percentage points.
equipment.drawback: Electrical resistance decreases 5 percentage points, minimum -20%.
equipment.counterplay: Use electrical pressure.

equipment.name: Grounding Coat
equipment.effect: Electrical resistance increases 12 percentage points.
equipment.drawback: Walking speed decreases 3%.
equipment.counterplay: Kite with other channels.

equipment.name: Vitriol Shell
equipment.effect: Corrosive resistance increases 12 percentage points.
equipment.drawback: Thermal resistance decreases 5 percentage points, minimum -20%.
equipment.counterplay: Use thermal attacks.

equipment.name: Sigil Breastplate
equipment.effect: Arcane resistance increases 12 percentage points.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina decreases 8.
equipment.counterplay: Drain stamina with repeated approaches.

equipment.name: Glass Carapace
equipment.effect: Round-start shield is 25 health, lasting until broken.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health decreases 10.
equipment.counterplay: Strip the opening shield before committing.

equipment.name: Marcher's Mail
equipment.effect: Maximum stamina increases 15.
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana decreases 8.
equipment.counterplay: Force costly spell exchanges.

equipment.name: Reservoir Armor
equipment.effect: Maximum mana increases 15.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina decreases 10.
equipment.counterplay: Force repeated dodges and sprints.

equipment.name: Braced Harness
equipment.effect: Enemy displacement distance decreases 15% while grounded.
equipment.drawback: Dodge distance decreases 0.3 m.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure its shorter dodge.

equipment.name: Fracture Guard
equipment.effect: After cover within 3 m breaks, gain 15 shield for 2 s; 10 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health decreases 12.
equipment.counterplay: Wait out shield or break distant cover.

equipment.name: Bloodless Aegis
equipment.effect: Activate a 45-health shield for 3 s.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health decreases 15; shield obeys 100 cap.
equipment.counterplay: Bait activation, then wait or strip it.

equipment.name: Stone Respite
equipment.effect: Grounded stationary channel grants 15 health over 2 s, interrupted by damage; once per round.
equipment.activation: Armor input, 20 mana, once per round
equipment.drawback: Channel prevents attacks and sprint; healing uses round healing budget.
equipment.counterplay: Interrupt the visible stationary channel.

equipment.name: Pact Armor
equipment.effect: Maximum health increases 40.
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana decreases 15 and sprint costs 2 more stamina/s.
equipment.counterplay: Exploit resource shortages and long chases.

equipment.name: Phoenix Carapace
equipment.effect: The first hit that takes wearer below 60 health grants 25 shield after damage for 2 s; cannot prevent lethal damage.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina decreases 12.
equipment.counterplay: Strip early shield then resume pressure.

equipment.name: Apprentice Mantle
equipment.effect: Mana regeneration increases 8%, within +40% cap.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health decreases 8.
equipment.counterplay: Maintain damage pressure before regeneration begins.

equipment.name: Dancing Sash
equipment.effect: Stamina regeneration increases 10%.
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana decreases 5.
equipment.counterplay: Force expensive spell exchanges.

equipment.name: Raincloak
equipment.effect: Self-applied wetness lasts 0.5 s less, minimum 0.5 s.
equipment.drawback: Beneficial wet-trigger effects have less time to activate.
equipment.counterplay: Use immediate Storm follow-ups.

equipment.name: Ember Cape
equipment.effect: Burning duration on wearer decreases 20%, minimum 0.5 s.
equipment.drawback: Water direct hits deal 5% more damage to wearer.
equipment.counterplay: Switch to Water direct attacks.

equipment.name: Snowveil
equipment.effect: Frost slow duration on wearer decreases 20%.
equipment.drawback: Heat direct hits deal 5% more damage to wearer.
equipment.counterplay: Use Heat or repeated Frost applications.

equipment.name: Groundwire Robe
equipment.effect: Wet electrical damage amplification against wearer is reduced by 25% of that amplification, not base damage.
equipment.drawback: Wearer remains conductive 0.5 s longer after leaving water.
equipment.counterplay: Strike immediately after the wearer leaves water.

equipment.name: Curtain of Moths
equipment.effect: Standing still inside obscured terrain for 1 s grants 1 s invisibility; 10 s cooldown; attacks, casts and damage break it, silhouette visible within 4 m.
equipment.drawback: Movement above walk breaks invisibility.
equipment.counterplay: Clear terrain or approach within silhouette range.

equipment.name: Dodgebinder Vest
equipment.effect: After dodging, next paid cast within 0.5 s costs 3 less mana; 5 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Spells cast while sprinting cost 2 extra mana.
equipment.counterplay: Force a melee response before the third spell.

equipment.name: Steam Weaver
equipment.effect: Entering steam within 2 s after any paid cast grants 10% walking speed for 1 s; 6 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Wetness on wearer lasts 0.5 s longer, max 8 s.
equipment.counterplay: Use connected Storm or attack the exit.

equipment.name: Glass Memory
equipment.effect: After missing a direct paid spell, its next cast within 3 s costs 3 less mana; 6 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: A second consecutive miss grants no refund and adds 0.1 s recovery.
equipment.counterplay: Vary movement to force consecutive misses.

equipment.name: Warden's Tabard
equipment.effect: While within 2 m of destructible cover, guard stamina cost falls 3.
equipment.drawback: Weapon attack stamina cost rises 2.
equipment.counterplay: Destroy cover or bait attacks.

equipment.name: Liminal Veil
equipment.effect: Become invisible for 1.25 s; attacks, casts or damage break it and silhouette is visible within 4 m.
equipment.drawback: Activation emits a visible flash and 8 m sound cue; no movement speed bonus.
equipment.counterplay: Track the cue and close within 4 m.

equipment.name: Mercurial Sleeves
equipment.effect: For 2 s, switching from one equipped spell to another cuts next spell preparation by 10%, once per activation.
equipment.drawback: The accelerated cast costs 3 extra mana.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure resources or bait an early activation.

equipment.name: Vest of Exchanges
equipment.effect: After casting a different equipped spell than the previous paid spell, gain 3 stamina; 2 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Repeating a spell costs 2 extra mana.
equipment.counterplay: Force repeated use of a defensive school.

equipment.name: Threadbare Miracle
equipment.effect: When wearer has no shield, first paid cast after taking 30 direct damage within 2 s grants 18 shield for 2 s; 12 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health decreases 18.
equipment.counterplay: Delay follow-up until shield expires.

equipment.name: Road Soles
equipment.effect: Sprint speed increases 3%, within +20% cap.
equipment.drawback: Sprint stamina cost increases 1/s.
equipment.counterplay: Force a prolonged sprint.

equipment.name: Softsteps
equipment.effect: Footstep audible radius decreases 15%.
equipment.drawback: Walking speed decreases 2%.
equipment.counterplay: Watch sightlines and cast flashes.

equipment.name: Runner's Laces
equipment.effect: Sprint stamina cost decreases 2/s.
equipment.drawback: Dodge costs 2 extra stamina.
equipment.counterplay: Force repeated dodges.

equipment.name: Vault Sandals
equipment.effect: Normal jump stamina cost decreases 3.
equipment.drawback: Airborne spell recovery increases 0.1 s.
equipment.counterplay: Attack during landing recovery.

equipment.name: Anchor Treads
equipment.effect: Enemy pushes while grounded move wearer 15% less distance.
equipment.drawback: Walking speed decreases 3%.
equipment.counterplay: Use ranged pressure instead of displacement.

equipment.name: Ice Grippers
equipment.effect: Reduce ice traction penalties by 25% of their normal amount.
equipment.drawback: Walking on ordinary ground is 2% slower.
equipment.counterplay: Fight off the ice.

equipment.name: Marsh Shoes
equipment.effect: Reduce shallow-liquid movement penalties by 25% of their normal amount.
equipment.drawback: Wearer retains wetness 0.5 s longer after leaving liquid.
equipment.counterplay: Use Storm follow-ups.

equipment.name: Cinder Heels
equipment.effect: Standing on a burning surface reduces that surface's damage to wearer 10%, within reduction cap.
equipment.drawback: Surface flames mark the wearer's footfalls visibly for 1 s.
equipment.counterplay: Track footfalls or use direct hits.

equipment.name: Copper Soles
equipment.effect: Paid cast started within 0.3 s after landing costs 3 less mana; 4 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Wet electrical damage taken increases 5%.
equipment.counterplay: Punish landings with Storm on wet terrain.

equipment.name: Cliff Straps
equipment.effect: Normal jump apex height increases 10%; still no flight.
equipment.drawback: Jump stamina cost increases 3.
equipment.counterplay: Read the longer airborne exposure.

equipment.name: Wallstep Shoes
equipment.effect: Once per 6 s, jump beside solid vertical cover adds a 1 m lateral shove away from wall, costing 5 stamina.
equipment.drawback: Cannot activate during an existing dash or in air without nearby wall.
equipment.counterplay: Control the wall exit.

equipment.name: Brake Boots
equipment.effect: Releasing sprint stops wearer 20% sooner; no displacement resistance.
equipment.drawback: Restarting sprint costs 3 stamina in addition to normal drain.
equipment.counterplay: Force repeated stop-start movement.

equipment.name: Feint Spurs
equipment.effect: After dodging and casting a different spell within 0.5 s, dodge cooldown is reduced by 0.15 s once; permanent reduction cap still applies.
equipment.drawback: Dodge stamina cost increases 3.
equipment.counterplay: Force empty dodges without a follow-up cast.

equipment.name: Traveler's Burst
equipment.effect: Dash 4 m in chosen ground direction, obeying collision; no invulnerability.
equipment.drawback: Consumes one of max 2 dash charges; cannot activate during another dash or dodge.
equipment.counterplay: Read the visible start and punish the destination.

equipment.name: Perimeter Steps
equipment.effect: At least 2 m from the current closing boundary, dodges toward arena center cost 5 less stamina.
equipment.drawback: Dodges toward boundary cost 5 more stamina; does not protect against boundary damage.
equipment.counterplay: Control center and predict inward dodges.

equipment.name: Pocket Reservoir
equipment.effect: Maximum mana increases 8.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina decreases 4.
equipment.counterplay: Force evasive movement.

equipment.name: Marathon Bead
equipment.effect: Maximum stamina increases 8.
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana decreases 4.
equipment.counterplay: Force resource-intensive spell exchanges.

equipment.name: Pulse Locket
equipment.effect: Maximum health increases 10.
equipment.drawback: Mana regeneration decreases 3%.
equipment.counterplay: Keep pressure on mana recovery.

equipment.name: Sundial Fragment
equipment.effect: One spell equipped in slot 1 has 8% shorter cooldown, counting toward 25% permanent reduction cap.
equipment.drawback: That spell costs 2 extra mana.
equipment.counterplay: Bait the more frequent but costly cast.

equipment.name: Empty Hourglass
equipment.effect: While all six spells are cooling, gain 15% mana regeneration after ordinary delay.
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana decreases 5.
equipment.counterplay: Attack while every spell is unavailable.

equipment.name: Arcane Abacus
equipment.effect: After paying at least 30 mana in 2 s, refund 5 mana once per 8 s to the last cast, within 25% refund cap.
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana decreases 8.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure immediately after expensive casting.

equipment.name: Glass Ear
equipment.effect: Audible enemy casting within 8 m supplies a direction-only UI tick for 0.5 s, once per 2 s; obeys sound occlusion.
equipment.drawback: Owner's cast sounds travel 2 m farther.
equipment.counterplay: Use sound occlusion or fake casts.

equipment.name: Survey Lens
equipment.effect: Displays remaining cooldown to one decimal for all equipped spells and remaining visible owned field lifetime within 10 m.
equipment.drawback: Maximum stamina decreases 3.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure the slightly longer cast.

equipment.name: Mirror Shard
equipment.effect: Taking at least 40 direct damage from one cast marks the attack's origin point for owner for 1 s; no tracking reveal.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health decreases 8.
equipment.counterplay: Move after the high-damage cast.

equipment.name: Broken Ward Seal
equipment.effect: A shield breaking from enemy damage grants 5 stamina once per 6 s.
equipment.drawback: All self-granted shields have 5 less capacity, minimum 1.
equipment.counterplay: Use small hits or force shields to expire naturally.

equipment.name: Leechstone
equipment.effect: Direct spell lifesteal is 3%, capped with all sources at 10% and 20 healing/s.
equipment.drawback: Maximum health decreases 12; no healing from procs, summons or props.
equipment.counterplay: Deny direct hits and punish lower health.

equipment.name: Two-Faced Coin
equipment.effect: Alternate direct weapon and spell hits within 2 s to grant 3 stamina per completed pair; 3 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Two consecutive weapon hits reset the pair.
equipment.counterplay: Deny one half of the pair.

equipment.name: Beacon Charm
equipment.effect: Place a visible 15-health beacon within 6 m; for 3 s it emits a 2 m light pulse each second, exposing visible silhouettes only.
equipment.drawback: Counts as one of max 2 summons; pulses locate wearer’s chosen scouting point.
equipment.counterplay: Destroy the beacon or remain behind opaque cover.

equipment.name: Silenced Quill
equipment.effect: After a successful advanced cast variation, next different paid spell costs 2 less mana; 3 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Repeating a spell gains nothing; commitment and telegraph unchanged.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure through audible cadence.

equipment.name: Concord Ring
equipment.effect: Hitting with 4 different paid spells within 6 s grants 20 shield for 2 s; 12 s cooldown.
equipment.drawback: Missing a direct paid cast removes current progress.
equipment.counterplay: Dodge a cast to break the sequence.

equipment.name: Clearwater Flask
equipment.effect: Remove wetness and reduce remaining burning duration by 1 s on self; no health restoration.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, instant, 1 charge per purchase, 1 s use recovery
equipment.drawback: Removes beneficial wet-trigger opportunities.
equipment.counterplay: Apply the state again after use.

equipment.name: Mana Draught
equipment.effect: Restore 15 mana over 1.5 s; damage interrupts remaining restoration.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.3 s use time, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Cannot cast during the 0.3 s use; no overfill.
equipment.counterplay: Interrupt after the visible drinking animation.

equipment.name: Stamina Tonic
equipment.effect: Restore 20 stamina over 1 s.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.3 s use time, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Sprint unavailable during restoration.
equipment.counterplay: Pressure the drinking window.

equipment.name: Bandage of Return
equipment.effect: Restore 20 health over 2 s if no damage is received; consumes healing budget.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.5 s use time, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Damage cancels remaining healing; cannot attack during use.
equipment.counterplay: Interrupt with direct damage.

equipment.name: Smoke Seed
equipment.effect: Create neutral 2 m-radius opaque smoke at own feet for 3 s; no damage.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, instant, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Blocks user's sight too; counts toward 3 fields.
equipment.counterplay: Use sound or clear the field.

equipment.name: Pocket Rain
equipment.effect: Create a connected 1.5 m-radius wet patch at a visible point within 5 m for 3 s, strength 1.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.25 s throw, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Wets wearer if entered and conducts explicit Storm reactions.
equipment.counterplay: Avoid the visible splash or exploit its conductivity.

equipment.name: Rime Dust
equipment.effect: Freeze at most 1 strength of wet patch within 4 m into fragile 20-health ice for 3 s; no player hard control.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.25 s throw, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Owner suffers same ice traction; counts toward fields.
equipment.counterplay: Shatter the ice or approach from dry ground.

equipment.name: Stone Wedge
equipment.effect: Place a 0.75 m-wide, 1 m-high 40-health barricade at a visible point within 2 m for 5 s. Its moss-backed rim carries Growth strength 1 within 0.5 m of the barricade, for the same 5 s lifetime and field allocation.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.4 s place, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Can block owner; counts toward 3 fields.
equipment.counterplay: Break or flank the small barricade.

equipment.name: Antidote Ampoule
equipment.effect: Remove up to 2 s of one named Venom damage-over-time effect; no healing or control removal.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.3 s use, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Other poison effects remain; use exposes wearer.
equipment.counterplay: Reapply Venom after use.

equipment.name: Emergency Ward
equipment.effect: Grant 35 shield for 2 s, within 100 cap.
equipment.activation: Consumable input, 0.2 s use, 1 charge per purchase
equipment.drawback: Maximum mana temporarily decreases 10 until shield ends; never saves an already lethal hit.
equipment.counterplay: Bait ward and wait 2 s.

augments.name: Steady Hand
augments.condition: Release a direct projectile after keeping aim within a 1-degree cone for 0.3 s. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Gain 6% projectile speed.
augments.drawback: Sprinting resets preparation.
augments.counterplay: Force tracking changes before release.

augments.name: Measured Breath
augments.condition: Complete an optional advanced voice or equivalent rhythm variation. Draft requirement: Oren Vey, using spoken syllables or equivalent rhythm keys.
augments.rank1: Paid cast costs 6% less mana.
augments.drawback: Benefit requires full normal cast commitment and audible telegraph.
augments.counterplay: Pressure during the spoken or rhythmic commitment.

augments.name: Clean Glyph
augments.condition: Complete optional gesture variation with no more than one correction. Draft requirement: a tracing/geometry/engraving wizard: WIZ-003,009,025 or 031.
augments.rank1: Paid cast costs 6% less mana.
augments.drawback: Aim remains committed to the gesture until completion.
augments.counterplay: Rush during gesture input.

augments.name: Ordered Mind
augments.condition: Complete optional ordered-input variation without wrong inputs. Draft requirement: a sequence, chord, memory or puzzle wizard from the listed wizard predicate.
augments.rank1: Gain 5% direct damage on that cast.
augments.rank2: Gain 8% direct damage on that cast.
augments.drawback: An incorrect optional input grants no bonus, normal spell remains available.
augments.counterplay: Force attention shifts during input.

augments.name: On the Beat
augments.condition: Complete optional timing variation within the wizard's published timing window. Draft requirement: a cadence, meter, scheduled-release or timing wizard from the listed predicate.
augments.rank1: Gain 6% preparation speed for that cast.
augments.rank2: Gain 10% preparation speed for that cast.
augments.drawback: Window remains fixed; benefit does not shorten the telegraph floor.
augments.counterplay: Vary attack timing to disrupt cadence.

augments.name: Anchored Cast
augments.condition: Release a paid advanced variation while stationary and grounded for 0.4 s. Draft requirement: mastery-tagged equipment equipped and round 3 or later.
augments.rank1: Gain 7% direct damage.
augments.drawback: Moving before release removes bonus.
augments.counterplay: Attack the planted position.

augments.name: Flying Script
augments.condition: Complete advanced variation while airborne. Draft requirement: projectile spell and movement-tagged equipment equipped.
augments.rank1: Gain 7% projectile speed.
augments.drawback: Landing before release removes bonus; incoming airborne hits remain normal.
augments.counterplay: Attack the predictable landing.

augments.name: Tracking Thesis
augments.condition: Maintain direct channel hits on enemy for 1 s, with no gap longer than 0.6 s.
augments.rank1: Refund 2 mana once when channel ends.
augments.rank2: Refund 4 mana once when channel ends.
augments.drawback: Sustained direct channel break resets tracking; refund obeys 25% cap.
augments.counterplay: Use cover before the one-second threshold.

augments.name: Needle Discipline
augments.condition: A direct projectile hits within 0.2 m of a head weak point. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Gain 5% direct damage, within 1.25 precision cap.
augments.rank2: Gain 8% direct damage, within 1.25 precision cap.
augments.drawback: Non-precision projectile damage decreases 3%.
augments.counterplay: Strafe and change head elevation.

augments.name: Quick Study
augments.condition: Use advanced variations on 2 different spells within 4 s. Draft requirement: sequence-tagged equipment and no active equipment equipped.
augments.rank1: Second variation costs 7% less mana.
augments.drawback: Repeated spell resets progress.
augments.counterplay: Force repetition of the defensive spell.

augments.name: Three-Part Cadence
augments.condition: Hit with 3 independently paid advanced casts within 5 s. Draft requirement: a prior three-distinct-spell-hit duel and equipped mastery item.
augments.rank1: Third cast refunds 3 mana.
augments.drawback: A miss resets progress; only direct hits count.
augments.counterplay: Dodge one of the three casts.

augments.name: Perfect Landing
augments.condition: Release a normal paid spell 0.1-0.25 s after landing.
augments.rank1: Cost decreases 2 mana.
augments.drawback: Landing outside the window grants nothing.
augments.counterplay: Displace or pressure the landing.

augments.name: Patient Cursor
augments.condition: Track visible enemy within 2-degree aim cone for 0.6 s before release. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Next direct projectile gains 5% damage.
augments.drawback: Cover or loss of aim resets preparation.
augments.counterplay: Break line of sight during preparation.

augments.name: Parry Syntax
augments.condition: Complete advanced cast variation within 0.5 s after perfect guard. Draft requirement: a prior two-perfect-guard duel and equipped guard item.
augments.rank1: Cost decreases 8% mana.
augments.drawback: Ordinary guard grants no bonus.
augments.counterplay: Feint before guard and delay the next attack.

augments.name: No Wasted Stroke
augments.condition: Complete two gesture variations with different spells within 4 s. Draft requirement: a listed tracing wizard and equipped mana item.
augments.rank1: Second cast gains 6% preparation speed.
augments.drawback: Wrong optional stroke resets progress.
augments.counterplay: Force the caster to aim elsewhere.

augments.name: Double Enunciation
augments.condition: Complete voice/rhythm variations on different spells within 3 s. Draft requirement: Oren Vey and equipped sequence item.
augments.rank1: Second direct cast gains 5% damage.
augments.drawback: Both casts keep their full audible cadence.
augments.counterplay: Read the consecutive audible casts.

augments.name: Recovered Rhythm
augments.condition: Fail one optional timing variation, then succeed on a different spell within 4 s. Draft requirement: a cadence, meter, scheduled-release or timing wizard from the listed predicate.
augments.rank1: Successful cast refunds 2 mana.
augments.drawback: Intentional failure still pays normal cast costs and cooldown.
augments.counterplay: Pressure the recovery cast.

augments.name: Deliberate Repetition
augments.condition: Complete advanced variations on the same spell twice, at least 1 s apart. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Second variation gains 7% projectile speed.
augments.drawback: A different spell resets progress.
augments.counterplay: Adapt to the repeated projectile.

augments.name: Pressure Examination
augments.condition: Complete a paid advanced variation below 90 health.
augments.rank1: Gain 7 shield for 1 s, 5 s cooldown.
augments.rank2: Gain 12 shield for 1 s, 5 s cooldown.
augments.drawback: No bonus for normal casts; shield follows 100 cap.
augments.counterplay: Interrupt through committed input or wait out shield.

augments.name: Magnum Opus
augments.condition: Hit with advanced variations of 4 different spells within 6 s.
augments.rank1: Fourth cast gains 8% direct damage.
augments.drawback: A miss resets progress; total mastery damage/speed bonus capped at 15%.
augments.counterplay: Dodge the fourth distinct cast.

augments.name: Disciplined Loadout
augments.condition: Complete advanced variation while wearing two mastery-tagged items. Draft requirement: two mastery-tagged items equipped and round 9 or later.
augments.rank1: Gain 2 stamina, 3 s cooldown.
augments.drawback: Normal casts grant nothing; total mastery efficiency cap remains 20%.
augments.counterplay: Pressure advanced input commitment.

augments.name: Graduated Lens
augments.condition: Own Steady Hand rank 1 and hit with a paid mastery projectile after walking 0.5 s. Draft requirement: Steady Hand rank 1 and projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Gain 4% projectile speed.
augments.drawback: Sprinting resets walk preparation; total mastery bonus capped 15%.
augments.counterplay: Force sprint or abrupt aim changes.

augments.name: Proven Under Pressure
augments.condition: After proving 5 mastery casts in a completed duel, complete an advanced variation below 75 health. Draft requirement: a prior five-mastery-cast duel and equipped shield item.
augments.rank1: Gain 10 shield for 1 s, 8 s cooldown.
augments.rank2: Gain 16 shield for 1 s, 8 s cooldown.
augments.drawback: Maximum health decreases 8.
augments.counterplay: Interrupt committed input or wait out shield.

augments.name: Many Instruments
augments.condition: Complete an advanced variation after using both weapon and different spell in previous 2 s. Draft requirement: melee-tagged and sequence-tagged items equipped.
augments.rank1: Refund 4% paid mana.
augments.drawback: A missed direct action resets setup; shared 25% refund cap.
augments.counterplay: Deny one action in the sequence.

augments.name: Fast Release
augments.condition: Cast a straight direct projectile. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Projectile speed increases 8%.
augments.drawback: Projectile lifetime falls 8%, reducing maximum travel range.
augments.counterplay: Use cover and force longer shots.

augments.name: Heavy Core
augments.condition: Cast a direct projectile. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Direct damage increases 5%.
augments.drawback: Projectile speed decreases 8%.
augments.counterplay: Dodge the slower projectile.

augments.name: Broad Tip
augments.condition: Cast a single direct projectile with radius below 0.3 m. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Radius increases 0.02 m.
augments.drawback: Direct damage decreases 5%; never enlarges beams or fields.
augments.counterplay: Guard or use solid cover.

augments.name: Fine Tip
augments.condition: Cast a direct projectile with radius above 0.08 m. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Direct damage increases 6%.
augments.drawback: Radius decreases 15%, minimum 0.08 m.
augments.counterplay: Vary strafe speed.

augments.name: One Ricochet
augments.condition: An untransformed straight projectile strikes stone or metal at a shallow angle. Draft requirement: projectile spell and terrain-tagged equipment equipped.
augments.rank1: Bounce once, retain 45% damage.
augments.drawback: Cannot split, portal, return, curve or ricochet again; bounce path glows.
augments.counterplay: Move away from the visible rebound path.

augments.name: Ground Skimmer
augments.condition: A projectile travels within 0.3 m of solid ground for at least 2 m. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Speed increases 7%.
augments.drawback: Airborne-target damage decreases 5%.
augments.counterplay: Jump or choose elevated cover.

augments.name: High Arc
augments.condition: Projectile release occurs at least 1 m above enemy feet. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Prop damage increases 12%.
augments.drawback: Player damage decreases 3%.
augments.counterplay: Fight under overhead cover.

augments.name: Range Compression
augments.condition: Direct projectile hits within 5 m. Draft requirement: projectile spell and melee item equipped.
augments.rank1: Damage increases 6%.
augments.drawback: Damage beyond 15 m decreases 8%.
augments.counterplay: Keep beyond close range.

augments.name: Range Extension
augments.condition: Direct projectile hits beyond 15 m. Draft requirement: projectile spell and precision item equipped.
augments.rank1: Damage increases 6%.
augments.drawback: Damage within 5 m decreases 8%.
augments.counterplay: Approach through cover.

augments.name: Beam Furnace
augments.condition: Maintain an uninterrupted direct sustained direct channel for 0.8 s. Draft requirement: at least one sustained direct channel spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Subsequent sustained direct channel damage increases 5%.
augments.rank2: Subsequent sustained direct channel damage increases 8%.
augments.drawback: Sustained direct channel mana drain increases 8%; contact break resets bonus.
augments.counterplay: Break sustained direct channel contact early.

augments.name: Beam Economizer
augments.condition: Maintain a direct sustained direct channel on enemy for 0.8 s. Draft requirement: sustained direct channel spell and mana item equipped.
augments.rank1: At channel end refund 1 mana per whole successful-contact second after first 0.8 s, maximum 3, paid once.
augments.rank2: At channel end refund 2 mana per whole successful-contact second after first 0.8 s, maximum 6, paid once.
augments.drawback: All refunds share 25% cap; missed contact ends refunds.
augments.counterplay: Duck behind cover.

augments.name: Sweep Practice
augments.condition: Sustained direct channel directly hits 2 distinct destructible props in one paid cast. Draft requirement: sustained direct channel spell and terrain item equipped.
augments.rank1: Second prop hit gains 12 damage.
augments.drawback: Sustained direct channel player damage decreases 3%.
augments.counterplay: Fight away from fragile props.

augments.name: Pulse Beam
augments.condition: End a damaging channel after holding 0.5-0.8 s.
augments.rank1: Its last actual direct hit gains 5 damage; does not add another hit.
augments.rank2: Its last actual direct hit gains 8 damage; does not add another hit.
augments.drawback: Holding longer grants no final-tick bonus.
augments.counterplay: Break sight during the release window.

augments.name: First Contact
augments.condition: A direct projectile hits an enemy with full health. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Damage increases 5%.
augments.drawback: Damage against enemies below 75 health decreases 3%.
augments.counterplay: Use cover until a small hit removes full-health condition.

augments.name: Last Crossing
augments.condition: A direct projectile hits during enemy landing recovery. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Damage increases 6%.
augments.drawback: Projectiles hitting grounded walking enemies deal 3% less damage.
augments.counterplay: Avoid predictable jump arcs.

augments.name: Cover Seam
augments.condition: Direct projectile destroys cover in one hit. Draft requirement: projectile spell and terrain item equipped; prior two-cover-break duel.
augments.rank1: Carry 20% remaining damage forward along original path, maximum 4 m.
augments.rank2: Carry 30% remaining damage forward along original path, maximum 4 m.
augments.drawback: Only untransformed projectile; one generation; never pierces players.
augments.counterplay: Stand away from the cover's rear face.

augments.name: Prepared Patience
augments.condition: A paid spell has at least 0.4 s declared windup and caster stays grounded through release.
augments.rank1: Cost decreases 6% mana.
augments.drawback: Walking speed during this preparation decreases 5%.
augments.counterplay: Push during the charge.

augments.name: Quick Recovery
augments.condition: A paid spell with no more than 0.3 s windup releases.
augments.rank1: Post-release recovery decreases 0.05 s, minimum 0.1 s.
augments.rank2: Post-release recovery decreases 0.1 s, minimum 0.1 s.
augments.drawback: That spell direct damage decreases 5%; cooldown unchanged.
augments.counterplay: Guard quick repeated low-damage releases.

augments.name: Visible Afterimage
augments.condition: An untransformed projectile misses an enemy within 1 m. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Leave inert glowing path for 0.5 s; next different spell within 1 s costs 2 less mana.
augments.rank2: Leave inert glowing path for 0.75 s; next different spell within 1 s costs 3 less mana.
augments.drawback: Trail helps opponent track casting direction; 4 s cooldown.
augments.counterplay: Follow the trail and dodge the second cast.

augments.name: Narrow Verdict
augments.condition: Direct projectile hits an enemy visible through a gap narrower than 1 m. Draft requirement: at least one projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Damage increases 7%.
augments.drawback: Projectile radius decreases 10%; no bonus through concealment.
augments.counterplay: Change position behind cover.

augments.name: Second Sightline
augments.condition: After one ricochet hits a destructible, next different untransformed projectile within 2 s. Draft requirement: One Ricochet rank 1 and projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Gain 7% projectile speed.
augments.drawback: Ricochet itself cannot carry another transform.
augments.counterplay: Change the second sightline immediately.

augments.name: Planted Battery
augments.condition: Sustained direct channel contact while grounded and wearing mana-tagged equipment. Draft requirement: sustained direct channel spell and mana item equipped.
augments.rank1: Refund 2 mana after 1 s contact, once per cast.
augments.rank2: Refund 3 mana after 1 s contact, once per cast.
augments.drawback: Standing in place is required; refund cap applies.
augments.counterplay: Break contact or flank the planted caster.

augments.name: Proven Sharpshooter
augments.condition: After proving 3 hits from 15 m in a duel, direct projectile hits after a dodge within 1 s. Draft requirement: projectile spell equipped and prior three-hits-from 15 m duel.
augments.rank1: Gain 6% direct damage.
augments.drawback: Projectile mana cost increases 2.
augments.counterplay: Punish the readable dodge-shot timing.

augments.name: Forked Argument
augments.condition: A split projectile hits enemy after another different spell hit within 1 s. Draft requirement: Forked Hazel equipped and projectile spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Add 3 arcane proc damage once per original cast.
augments.rank2: Add 5 arcane proc damage once per original cast.
augments.drawback: Never one proc per branch; cannot trigger another on-hit effect.
augments.counterplay: Dodge the earlier spell or guard the split branches.

augments.name: Wide Foundation
augments.condition: Create a non-damaging field. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Radius increases 0.2 m.
augments.drawback: Paid mana cost increases 2.
augments.counterplay: Stay beyond the visible edge.

augments.name: Compact Hazard
augments.condition: Create a damaging field. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Initial direct damage increases 5%.
augments.drawback: Radius decreases 10%.
augments.counterplay: Move outside the smaller field.

augments.name: Slow Dissipation
augments.condition: Create a field with normal lifetime at most 6 s. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Lifetime increases 0.5 s.
augments.drawback: Initial direct damage decreases 5%; all lifetimes remain <=8 s.
augments.counterplay: Wait or clear the field.

augments.name: Quick Dissipation
augments.condition: Create a field. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Initial direct damage increases 6%.
augments.drawback: Lifetime decreases 1 s, minimum 1 s.
augments.counterplay: Evade placement then wait out shorter duration.

augments.name: Remote Survey
augments.condition: Place a field beyond 8 m. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Cost decreases 2 mana.
augments.drawback: Fields within 3 m cost 2 extra mana.
augments.counterplay: Close before placement.

augments.name: Home Circle
augments.condition: Place a field within 2 m of self. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Cost decreases 2 mana.
augments.drawback: Fields beyond 10 m cost 2 extra mana.
augments.counterplay: Fight at range.

augments.name: Edge Casting
augments.condition: Begin a spell while within 0.5 m of a field edge. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Preparation decreases 5%.
augments.drawback: Must be grounded; field center grants no bonus.
augments.counterplay: Push caster away from edge.

augments.name: Stone Stitch
augments.condition: Earth cover is created touching existing solid cover. Draft requirement: Earth terrain spell and terrain item equipped.
augments.rank1: New cover gains 8 health.
augments.drawback: Cover creation costs 2 additional mana.
augments.counterplay: Flank or destroy the joint.

augments.name: Ice Joinery
augments.condition: Create an ice construct touching wet ground. Draft requirement: Frost spell and wet item or Pocket Rain equipped.
augments.rank1: Construct gains 8 health.
augments.drawback: Consumes 0.5 strength of wet ground.
augments.counterplay: Break the joint with Heat or blunt damage.

augments.name: Sand Buttress
augments.condition: Create Sand cover on dry ground. Draft requirement: an equipped sand spell.
augments.rank1: Construct gains 10 health.
augments.drawback: Direct Water damage against it increases 10%.
augments.counterplay: Use Water to break it.

augments.name: Breaker's Dividend
augments.condition: Destroy enemy-created cover with a direct spell.
augments.rank1: Gain 3 stamina, 4 s cooldown.
augments.drawback: Direct player damage decreases 2%.
augments.counterplay: Abandon vulnerable cover and attack directly.

augments.name: Safe Corridor
augments.condition: Your field is created without overlapping another field. Draft requirement: at least one field spell equipped.
augments.rank1: Cost decreases 5% mana.

augments.drawback: Creation under a ceiling costs 2 extra mana.

augments.name: Sheltered Work

augments.drawback: Field creation outdoors has 0.05 s longer preparation.

augments.name: Surveyed Demolition

biomes.name: Raincourt
biomes.visual_identity: Blue slate terraces and copper gutters
biomes.environment_rule: Every 8 s a 0.5 s visible rainfall pulse adds one water unit to the two mirrored 2 m gutter beds, up to four. No rain wets players automatically.
biomes.tactical_use: Build connected wet lanes or ground their electricity; central slate stays dry.
biomes.fairness: Dry routes remain on both flanks; wet cells are marked in preview.

biomes.name: Ember Orchard
biomes.visual_identity: Charred fruit trees and black basalt
biomes.environment_rule: Two mirrored 2 m root beds start with Heat 1 and Growth 1. Their fuel is exhausted after one ignition unless a player adds growth.
biomes.tactical_use: Burn temporary growth to open cover or quench the route.
biomes.fairness: Anchored trunks do not burn; both sides receive equal fuel.

biomes.name: Glass Observatory
biomes.visual_identity: Clear prisms and rotating brass star maps
biomes.environment_rule: Two anchored prisms allow one reflected ray at 70% retained damage. Their orientation is fixed for the duel and shown in preview.
biomes.tactical_use: Aim at predictable reflected lanes or break prism durability.
biomes.fairness: Reflections cannot strike spawn alcoves or loop.

biomes.name: Rime Foundry
biomes.visual_identity: Frosted iron plates and furnace shells
biomes.environment_rule: Two shallow mirrored water tiles begin frozen with 45 durability. They thaw normally; no automatic refreeze.
biomes.tactical_use: Use melt-to-steam transitions or shatter ice into a short cone.
biomes.fairness: Central floor is rough stone and never slippery.

biomes.name: Moss Archive
biomes.visual_identity: Shelves of stone tablets and living vines
biomes.environment_rule: Each mirrored porous wall absorbs its first water unit and releases it to one adjacent floor cell when struck for 20 damage.
biomes.tactical_use: Store water in cover for a later reaction.
biomes.fairness: Only marked porous cover has this behavior; no hidden water store.

biomes.name: Thunder Causeway
biomes.visual_identity: Conductive rails over stable rock
biomes.environment_rule: Four visible 3 m rail sections conduct a bounded electrical branch, stopping at insulated gaps.
biomes.tactical_use: Redirect a chain through a rail or stand in its insulated gap.
biomes.fairness: No rail reaches a spawn or the entire final circle.

biomes.name: Silt Basin
biomes.visual_identity: Damp sand around ruined fountains
biomes.environment_rule: Two 2 m beds start with Sand 2 Water 1; their damp state suppresses dust for 3 s, then decays without refill.
biomes.tactical_use: Dry a bed to raise dust or maintain a clear approach.
biomes.fairness: Rough stone bypasses both beds; no mandatory slow.

biomes.name: Moon Cloister
biomes.visual_identity: Pale walls with alternating light shafts
biomes.environment_rule: Two marked light shafts reduce a shadow field lifetime by 1 s per second; ambient darkness never hides a player itself.
biomes.tactical_use: Place concealment outside bright patches or push an enemy into light.
biomes.fairness: Brightness and contrast remain equivalent on all graphics settings.

biomes.name: Resonance Hall
biomes.visual_identity: Stone ribs and suspended acoustic bells
biomes.environment_rule: Two acoustic plates ring for 1 s when hit by a player or damaging prop; the ring gives public direction without revealing through-wall silhouettes.
biomes.tactical_use: Mask or bait movement with a timed bell impact.
biomes.fairness: Both players hear identical public rings; no auto-target.

biomes.name: Floating Quarry
biomes.visual_identity: Anchored stepping rock and gravity lamps
biomes.environment_rule: Two 2 m low-gravity pads reduce fall damage by 50% while standing on them and show an overhead marker. No jump-height bonus.
biomes.tactical_use: Use predictable safe landings or deny a pad.
biomes.fairness: Pads do not alter server projectile velocity or grant flight.

biomes.name: Windmill Yard
biomes.visual_identity: Canvas sails and sandy cobble
biomes.environment_rule: Every 12 s an announced 2 s gust moves clouds up to 2 m along the shown compass direction; force strength 1.
biomes.tactical_use: Plan a shifting screen or expose a protected approach.
biomes.fairness: The gust does not move players or damaging props.

biomes.name: Copper Baths
biomes.visual_identity: Shallow baths and grounded statues
biomes.environment_rule: Each grounded statue absorbs one electrical branch, then loses its grounding for 4 s with a bright overload cue.
biomes.tactical_use: Spend a branch to exhaust safety or preserve a protected route.
biomes.fairness: No full-map conduction; max propagation remains 6 m.

biomes.name: Briar Greenhouse
biomes.visual_identity: Glass arches and trimmed living cover
biomes.environment_rule: Two 60-durability hedge panels may burn for 2 s before crumbling; they have one finite fuel layer.
biomes.tactical_use: Choose whether to remove a flank screen or use its brief burn.
biomes.fairness: No critical support is combustible; exits remain open.

biomes.name: Mirror Steps
biomes.visual_identity: Polished ramps and opaque mirror slabs
biomes.environment_rule: Mirrors reflect non-damaging spell preparation flashes only as public visual decoys; actual rays reflect only at marked prisms.
biomes.tactical_use: Use visible false flash direction to bait a peek.
biomes.fairness: Mirror art never presents a fake damaging projectile or false collision.

biomes.name: Ash Amphitheatre
biomes.visual_identity: Terraced basalt with dusty channels
biomes.environment_rule: Two dust beds begin Dust 2. A water unit suppresses one layer; a force impact above 20 raises a 3 s dust field.
biomes.tactical_use: Create a brief screen from terrain rather than a spell slot.
biomes.fairness: Each bed can raise one field before its dust is exhausted.

biomes.name: Fungal Vault
biomes.visual_identity: Luminous caps and porous pillars
biomes.environment_rule: Two marked caps release a 1 m 2 s cloud dealing 4 corrosive damage/s when destroyed; each cap is one-use.
biomes.tactical_use: Deny a tiny route or clear a cap before approach.
biomes.fairness: Clouds affect either player, remain visible, and cannot cover every route.

biomes.name: Oath Cemetery
biomes.visual_identity: Stone markers and spirit lanterns
biomes.environment_rule: Each lantern shatters once into a 2 s 1.5 m public silhouette illumination field; it reveals no player through solid cover.
biomes.tactical_use: Illuminate a nearby concealed flank or remove the lantern.
biomes.fairness: Lanterns are symmetric and cannot heal or grant resources.

biomes.name: Clockwork Atrium
biomes.visual_identity: Pendulum decor and brass shutters
biomes.environment_rule: Two shutters switch open/closed at combat 20 s and 40 s with 2 s warning. A player in a closure path causes that shutter to remain open.
biomes.tactical_use: Time a lane crossing or cast as a sightline opens.
biomes.fairness: Shutters stop switching before boundary contraction and never seal a route.

biomes.name: Blackwater Dock
biomes.visual_identity: Wood decks over bounded dark pools
biomes.environment_rule: Two 2 m pools are visually dark but use ordinary Water 2 states; visible edge patterns preserve readability.
biomes.tactical_use: Use water reactions without pretending darkness gives invisibility.
biomes.fairness: Every deck has two safe exits; liquid is shallow.

biomes.name: Sunforge Gallery
biomes.visual_identity: White stone and warm metal screens
biomes.environment_rule: Two heat sinks absorb the first 2 heat units touching their face, then stay visibly hot for 3 s without automatic damage.
biomes.tactical_use: Spend heat to warm a reaction surface or use it as limited shielding.
biomes.fairness: Absorption is finite and does not remove direct projectile damage.

biomes.name: Crystalline Grotto
biomes.visual_identity: Faceted rock and brittle shelves
biomes.environment_rule: Two 45-durability crystal covers fracture under a 20+ impact, producing the standard 10-damage shard cone.
biomes.tactical_use: Break cover from a chosen angle rather than randomly exploding it.
biomes.fairness: Only directional nearby shards deal damage; main ceiling is anchored.

biomes.name: Red Dune Court
biomes.visual_identity: Cloth canopies and heavy sand urns
biomes.environment_rule: Two medium urns spill a 2 m Dust 1 patch on destruction, finite once each. Wind can move its 3 s obscuration.
biomes.tactical_use: Choose where to break an urn to shape sight.
biomes.fairness: Canopies are visual only; solid cover remains obvious.

biomes.name: Magnetic Depot
biomes.visual_identity: Insulated crates and conductor coils
biomes.environment_rule: Two fixed coils deflect eligible physical projectiles by at most 10 degrees in a 1.5 m radius after a 0.25 s visible pulse on impact.
biomes.tactical_use: Trigger a small predictable deviation before the next shot.
biomes.fairness: One pulse percoil/4 s; no target-seeking and no beam bend.

biomes.name: Wellspring Forum
biomes.visual_identity: Circular masonry and sealed ritual basins
biomes.environment_rule: Two basins hold Water 2 and release one unit to an adjacent floorcell per direct impact, maximum two releases each.
biomes.tactical_use: Control a finite water supply with aimed hits.
biomes.fairness: No health/mana pickup; direct-hit procs cannot trigger on basins.

builds.name: Measured Crossfire
builds.objective: Hold a stable firing lane, prepare the focus reward behind cover, and reposition before the opponent can rush the same angle twice.
equipment_interactions: EQP-001 Surveyor's Point: After aiming without sprinting for 0.6s, the next direct projectile travels 10% faster. If no projectile spell is equipped, the prepared cast instead gains 5% shorter preparation.
EQP-051 Training Cuirass: Maximum health increases 15.
EQP-081 Road Soles: Sprint speed increases 3%, within +20% cap.
EQP-099 Sundial Fragment: One spell equipped in slot 1 has 8% shorter cooldown, counting toward 25% permanent reduction cap.
EQP-096 Pocket Reservoir: Maximum mana increases 8.
transformation_interactions: AUG-289 changes SPL-001: Ray can reflect once from a mirror prop at 27 damage; reflected segment visible.
AUG-293 changes SPL-003: Breaking ward leaves a 20-health light shard for 2 s; next enemy contact within 0.8 m takes 12.
AUG-292 changes SPL-002: Replace fan with one 0.7 m ray dealing 38.
builds.sequence: The first direct spell is a probe; alternate two different spells rather than repeatedly spending the heaviest ray. Use the defensive kit action to preserve the next preparation.
builds.mastery_connection: Keep the aim vector within a 2-degree cone for the final 0.25s and release with rings aligned: next direct spell gains 12% projectile speed, or 12% lower windup for nonprojectile spells, never both. Moving targets still require manual tracking.
builds.counterplay: Cover and changing elevation deny the stable reticle window.
builds.constraints: Six free selections: two Silver, two Gold, two Prismatic. All transformations target this wizard’s equipped spells. Equipment purchases respect round tier unlocks; the plan is a possible draft result, not a guaranteed shop outcome. All global caps apply.

builds.name: Kiln Assault
builds.objective: Force a short-range exchange, vent on the crest, and use heat on a finite wet or growth source to change the approach.
equipment_interactions: EQP-010 Palmwood Rod: Casting within 3m of the enemy grants 6 stamina after paid release; 3s internal cooldown.
EQP-053 Kilnplate: Thermal resistance increases 12 percentage points.
EQP-088 Cinder Heels: Standing on a burning surface reduces that surface's damage to wearer 10%, within reduction cap.
EQP-097 Marathon Bead: Maximum stamina increases 8.
EQP-105 Broken Ward Seal: A shield breaking from enemy damage grants 5 stamina once per 6s.
transformation_interactions: AUG-305 changes SPL-009: Fireball bounces once off ground at 36 direct or 20 splash.
AUG-309 changes SPL-011: Casting while Wet consumes Wet and creates 1.5 m steam puff for 1 s.
AUG-308 changes SPL-010: Cone becomes two 45-degree cones with a 30-degree center gap, damage 36 once.
builds.sequence: Commit heat only after checking which route the enemy can leave. A shield or movement spell covers the next crest rather than making every release a damage gamble.
builds.mastery_connection: Release within the marked 100ms crest window at 0.45s: direct damage gains 12%. On nondamaging spells, pay 12% less mana instead. One reward per spell.
builds.counterplay: A lateral dodge and water extinguishing can waste the committed heat window.
builds.constraints: Six free selections: two Silver, two Gold, two Prismatic. All transformations target this wizard’s equipped spells. Equipment purchases respect round tier unlocks; the plan is a possible draft result, not a guaranteed shop outcome. All global caps apply.

builds.name: Prepared Revision
builds.objective: Inscribed preparation happens behind cover; leave a setup that protects the next manual trace, then move before tracing again.
equipment_interactions: EQP-003 Loopwood Switch: Switching to a different equipped spell reduces that spell's next paid mana cost by 3 after 1s; 4s internal cooldown.
EQP-051 Training Cuirass: Maximum health increases 15.
EQP-083 Runner's Laces: Sprint stamina cost decreases 2/s.
EQP-096 Pocket Reservoir: Maximum mana increases 8.
EQP-109 Silenced Quill: After a successful advanced cast variation, next different paid spell costs 2 less mana; 3s cooldown.
transformation_interactions: AUG-321 changes SPL-017: Written dot emits one 20 m/s shard along original return line on recast, 16 damage.
AUG-325 changes SPL-019: Recast burns remaining shield into a 2 m cone dealing 18, ending guard.
AUG-324 changes SPL-018: Wall includes 1 m transparent shooting window that transmits projectile damage at 75%.
builds.sequence: Use the normal guided cast when pressured. Save the accurate trace for a gap created by a completed spell or field, with mana tools supporting the longer sequence.
builds.mastery_connection: Finish the three strokes within 0.75s with at least 85% path accuracy and endpoints within 8% of pane width: the spell costs 15% less mana. Shape scoring uses normalized pane coordinates, never raw mouse DPI.
builds.counterplay: Destroy the setup and pressure the camera-locked tracing window.
